@@ -0,0 +1,62 @@
+# 当前 run 的 I/O 加速与恢复
+
+适用 run：`statsfusion_v410_joint_event_20261007a`。用户已暂停在第八轮、已提交 1481 个 chunk，并授权启用源码级加速。模型、损失、学习率、AMP、chunk 长度、四个 session 的梯度累计、样本顺序、随机增强和验证协议保持一致。
+
+| 参数 | 原值 | 当前配置 |
+| --- | ---: | ---: |
+| `training.num_workers` | 10 | 10 |
+| `training.loader_prefetch_factor` | 1 | 4 |
+| `training.session_reader_cache_size` | 1 | 4 |
+
+预取队列上限由 10 个 batch 增至 40 个，配合 pinned memory 和非阻塞 CUDA 输入拷贝。每个 worker 缓存四个原始 archive，减少跨 archive 窗口的重复读取。DataLoader 仍按 sampler 顺序交付，增强仍由 seed、epoch、subject 和 session 决定，缓存只保存原始数组。
+同一训练分区复用读取 worker，避免 Windows 每轮重新启动十个 Python 进程；epoch 仍重新生成原有 subject/session/chunk 顺序，更换分区必须新建 dataset/loader。模型历史特征缓存仍按 epoch、subject/session 和 optimizer update 隔离。
+
+本机为 i9-14900HX、32 GB RAM、RTX 4080 Laptop 12 GB VRAM。检查时训练正常推进，GPU 利用率单次快照约 7%、已用显存约 2.5 GB、可用物理内存约 8.7 GB。快照只能说明当时资源状态，不能作为完整性能剖析。2125 个原始 archive 的解压后中位大小约 7.76 MiB、P95 约 18.68 MiB、最大约 63.90 MiB；十个 worker 各增加三个缓存的数组容量上限估计约 1.87 GiB，另有预取 batch、pinned memory 和 Python 管理开销。
+
+训练配置身份仍为 `ed8ca128a5cd7d301a936bba3bbefcd6e23933504c71af04712f4fa04debc235`。源码变化通过 `configs/statsfusion_v410_performance_resume_migration.json` 精确登记，包含监督目标批量生成、finite 检查合并、读取 worker 复用和 checkpoint 传输/序列化优化；模型文件不变。原始 identity、所有前序迁移 receipt、旧 checkpoint 和累计梯度保持原样。
+
+## 数值与性能
+
+3/15/60 秒监督目标取消逐端点 CUDA 标量同步。二值 target/mask 窗口采用精确整数计数和原浮点除法；非二值窗口继续使用原来的逐窗口浮点规约，因此 soft label 或有效 mask 不改变舍入顺序。缺失窗口、时间对齐与有效 bin 语义保持一致。
+
+finite 检查仍覆盖全部权重与累计梯度，但按 device 合并判定，减少多次 CPU/GPU 同步。checkpoint 的模型、optimizer 和梯度按 dtype/device 汇集拷至 CPU；CPU 历史状态先使用原生 pickle 封装，减少 Torch serializer 对大量历史诊断字段的逐对象处理。保存仍逐 chunk 同步、fsync 并原子 replace；没有降低保存频率或异步跳过提交。旧格式与新格式的 `torch.load(..., weights_only=False)` 都返回原来的 state 字典。
+
+实测结果：
+
+| 实测范围 | 原实现 | 新实现 | 局部提速 |
+| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
+| 实际输入、1137 步共享编码器/state/proposal 前后向 | 0.4423 s | 0.0870 s | 5.08 倍 |
+| 实际 checkpoint 的 GPU 拷贝与序列化 | 1.0617 s | 0.2714 s | 3.91 倍 |
+
+第一项逐参数梯度与 loss 完全一致，第二项恢复后的 state、model、optimizer、累计梯度和 RNG 完全一致。第一项峰值 GPU allocated/reserved 为约 1.29 GiB；完整 forward/backward 与原始 session 训练另执行资源测试，门槛为 10.5 GiB。上述局部测试不等于整轮训练或完整五折提速，checkpoint 测试不含磁盘 fsync；候选处理、calibration/search 和验证仍有耗时。
+
+## 生效与回退
+
+普通 `--resume` 自动验证并提交登记的性能迁移，无需额外 flag；先重新运行实现验证，再从第八轮第 1482 个 chunk 继续。已有完整 chunk、累计梯度、RNG 和 session/cache 游标继续保留；未提交 chunk 重新执行。备份及迁移证据写入 `resume_migrations/numerically_equivalent_performance_v1/` 和 `performance_resume_migration.json`。
+
+```powershell
+python scripts/run_statsfusion_joint.py `
+  --config configs/statsfusion_v410_joint_event.yaml `
+  --run-name statsfusion_v410_joint_event_20261007a `
+  --stage all --skip-s0 `
+  --historical-reference hierarchical_v4_r32_deep_frontier_20260930a `
+  --resume
+```
+
+若实际内存压力或稳定性变差，将 prefetch 和 reader-cache 降为 2，必要时改回 1 后恢复；worker 保持 10。这两个字段允许恢复，不影响模型配置身份。源码优化需要保留登记身份，不自行回退源码后继续该 run。
+
+本方案不承诺整轮固定提速倍率。没有启用 TF32、改变 dropout 随机序列的 compile/CUDA Graph、扩大监督 chunk、改变梯度累计或降低 checkpoint 频率；这些无法满足当前 run 的数值与恢复不变性要求。
+
+## 验收
+
+- 原始 archive 读取结果逐元素相同；跨两个 archive 的重复读取由八次解压减少至两次。
+- 真实 JointSessionDataset 的旋转、模态 dropout、missing mask、标签和时间轴在 prefetch/cache 更改后逐 tensor 相同；从中途 chunk 恢复也保持同一 sampler identity 和 batch 内容。
+- CPU/CUDA 的二值/soft/missing 监督目标、累计梯度和三轮训练后权重逐 tensor 相同。
+- CPU/CUDA Ctrl+C/OOM 恢复测试保留部分累计梯度，最终权重与不中断的参考训练逐 tensor 相同。
+- persistent loader 的 worker PID 保持不变，epoch RNG/顺序与新建 loader 一致，并拒绝跨 dataset/训练分区复用。
+- 实际 checkpoint 的紧凑状态封装恢复后重新 pickle 的 bytes 与原状态完全相同，optimizer、梯度和 RNG 逐 tensor 相同。
+- 当前 checkpoint SHA-256 固定为 `62565f6361310230db53893f75c6833f418166ed1b000f45ad2ae001aac5cdd9`，性能迁移只接受该已暂停断点及登记源码；正式验收包括全套 pytest、ruff、compileall 和 GPU/十 worker 资源测试。
+
+实际验收：启用 `BME_V410_RESOURCE_TESTS=1` 后，全套测试为 599 passed、1 skipped，耗时 210.22 秒；ruff、compileall 和 diff 检查通过。普通 `--stage audit --resume` 已提交性能迁移，`--stage validate --resume` 已重新验证当前实现；当前 run 保持 `PAUSED`，outer fold 0 未继续执行。
+
+另通过真实 `train_joint_model` 恢复入口，在第一个 chunk 之前停止核验：全部模型权重、两个 optimizer 参数组、353 个非空累计梯度、Python/NumPy/CPU/CUDA RNG、session/cache/history 和恢复游标与原断点一致。原 checkpoint、原 identity 和两层前序迁移 receipt 的 SHA-256 均未改变。测试与性能证据保存在 run 的 `performance_validation.json`，实际恢复入口证据保存在 `real_resume_validation.json`；其范围不包含新一轮完整模型训练或晋级成绩。

+# v4.10 当前训练暴露问题与优化优先级审查
+
+审查时间：2026-10-08，北京时间约18:11。对象：`statsfusion_v410_joint_event_20261007a`，协议 `statsfusion-joint-event-v1`，seed `[2026]`。本次分析读取当前源码、配置和已有训练产物，未执行额外模型训练或GPU性能测试。
+
+**结论：共享编码器路线已有积极的内部验证证据，但当前瓶颈集中在起点定位、候选级监督的有效利用、选模解释性，以及重复候选评分和搜索的实现开销。现有证据不足以认定需要增加hidden width、attention heads或新增大型Transformer。**
+
+## 1. 证据范围与当前状态
+
+当前已完成fold0、内部partition0的第8、10、12、14轮selector评估。selector有34个有效事件，曝光266.1008小时；fit有51个事件、346个session，每轮2021个chunk、87次optimizer更新。正式outer五折结果尚未完成。
+
+| 指标 | epoch8 | epoch10 | epoch12 | epoch14 |
+| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
+| 搜索后selector F1 | 0.5333 | 0.5231 | 0.6230 | 0.5902 |
+| TP/FP/FN | 16/10/18 | 17/14/17 | 19/8/15 | 18/9/16 |
+| 所选预算后的候选覆盖 | 33/34 | 32/34 | 32/34 | 28/34 |
+| FP/h | 0.03758 | 0.05261 | 0.03006 | 0.03382 |
+| 起点MAE，秒 | 320.9 | 275.4 | 534.2 | 469.9 |
+| 起点signed error，秒 | -91.9 | -110.4 | -523.2 | -415.9 |
+| 终点MAE，秒 | 167.5 | 148.4 | 79.6 | 147.4 |
+| 同手召回 | 0.5385 | 0.5385 | 0.6154 | 0.4615 |
+| 异手召回 | 0.4286 | 0.4762 | 0.5238 | 0.5714 |
+| clipping fraction | 0.0805 | 0.1379 | 0.1149 | 0.1149 |
+
+当前`selected.pt`保留epoch12。训练资格正常，单次epoch14回落不能直接诊断过拟合。各轮的操作点、校准器及匹配事件不同，MAE也不是同一TP集合的配对比较。selector同时参与选epoch、拟合校准及操作点搜索，不能把这些成绩作为独立正式结果。
+
+历史参考审计当前为`qualified=false`、`comparison_performed=false`；理由包含single-holdout协议缺乏合格完整outer OOF证据。S0仍显式跳过。即使后续绝对指标达到目标，也不能据此宣称优于合格历史参考或sensor-only。
+
+## 2. 模型架构：起点定位应优先修复
+
+**2.1 起点头没有直接进入当前候选解码。**
+
+联合模型输出并监督局部onset/offset。`pack_features()`保存二者，但`generate_chunk()`仅把state和3/15/60秒proposal概率以及offset送入`StreamingProposals.observe()`；onset概率没有直接用于起点生成、校正或候选判别输入。onset损失仍能更新共享局部表示，因此不能说该头完全无作用；问题是其显式起点证据尚未被解码器利用。
+
+建议让起点候选由已观测的局部onset峰及占用概率变化共同提供，起点版本继续保留来源和父边界。起点选择与长上下文事件语义分工：长上下文负责识别事件，局部证据负责定位。任何参数均在对应训练/内部OOF中锁定，并保持因果和前缀一致性。
+
+**2.2 固定600秒扩展、预算配额及粗边界可能共同放大提前起点。**
+
+`StreamingProposals._ready()`的backtrack与start-expansion都生成`start-600秒、end不变`的候选。同一父候选下，二者通常几何相同、来源元数据不同。预算在事件评分之前优先满足扩展来源欠额，最终提交以事件概率×质量排序。
+
+这一机制与epoch12/14的强烈负偏一致，但当前selector缺少所选预测逐事件来源表，尚不能证明具体多少TP来自扩展来源。必须先记录来源与残差，再做候选来源消融。
+
+建议采用onset证据约束的多个起点版本，并在family内部学习边界质量差异；几何相同的版本可共享ROI计算，但来源元数据不同的事件头输出不能直接复用。不要把所有预测固定后移600秒，也不要未经消融删除扩展来源，因为它仍可能挽救漏覆盖。
+
+**2.3 当前Boundary训练资格在这个fit分区内无法满足。**
+
+Boundary要求至少60个独立匹配正事件，而当前fit总共只有51个truth。实际epoch12的边界资格只有41个独立匹配事件，`qualified=false`；epoch8/10/12/14的共享编码器Boundary加权梯度诊断全部为零。
+
+这意味着当前selector模型的候选级Boundary分布头没有获得该训练损失，而局部onset/offset仍在训练。之后内部retrain训练集扩大，Boundary可能获得资格，但不会自动修复当前selector模型，也不保证选定训练时长足以训练新启用的头。
+
+建议下一协议区分“允许用合法训练标签学习边界”与“允许正式启用边界修正”。训练采用可获得的独立正事件，控制每事件贡献和正则化；启用决策继续依赖足够事件的跨主体OOF及原有硬门禁。保留coarse fallback。这个调整改变训练协议，必须新run。
+
+**2.4 长事件的16个内部ROI bins会压缩定位信息。**
+
+内部16 bins用于完整事件语义合理，但13022秒事件每bin跨度约814秒，不能依赖它提供精细起点定位。前后4 bins仅围绕候选粗起止点；粗起点过早时，真实onset可能处在很宽的内部bin里。
+
+建议保留全事件16 bins，同时给边界判别增加固定时间尺度的局部证据、onset/offset置信度及内外占用差异。优先优化输入信息和监督，不增加主干宽度。
+
+## 3. 训练策略：独立事件计数不能等同于只训练一个版本
+
+**3.1 设定的采样比例没有成为实际采样分布。**
+
+每chunk最多8个，最大余数法配额为positive2、near-miss2、hard-FP3、random-background1。已有审计如下，数字是trainer跨chunk/epoch去重之前的候选数：
+
+| epoch | positive | near-miss | hard-FP | random-background | 合计 | 平均每chunk |
+| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: |
+| 8 | 61 | 39 | 1284 | 1879 | 3263 | 1.61 |
+| 12 | 49 | 26 | 730 | 1882 | 2687 | 1.33 |
+| 14 | 52 | 24 | 826 | 1881 | 2783 | 1.38 |
+
+自然背景多和正事件稀少本身是数据事实。待优化处是有效正候选、near-miss及定位难例数量很少，不能把配置中的30%正样本当作实际已实现的训练比例。不能凭复制同family来补齐独立数量。
+
+建议在保持session顺序和合法因果时间的基础上，增加事件/边界贡献的均衡统计，允许不同质量的真实候选版本参与组内监督，记录缺额与实际进入loss的数量。需要候选池时只缓存已完成事件的合法候选，并保留模型更新、detach及过期身份。
+
+**3.2 当前跨epoch遍历内的去重限制了同事件和同family质量学习。**
+
+`sample_candidates()`在chunk内去重family和正事件；trainer又用`event_contributions`、`family_contributions`使同事件正样本或同family负样本在整个epoch中只贡献一次。这能控制重复权重，但一个较早抽到的粗候选可能消耗该事件本轮全部正样本资格，后续边界更准确的版本被跳过。
+
+质量头需要学习同一事件的好边界与差边界。建议保留独立事件/family计数，允许少量有差异的版本，以事件/family总权重固定的方式归一化；候选可以多，独立证据数量不膨胀。可增加组内质量排序监督，并保留严格IoU>0.25的事件目标与连续IoU质量目标分离。
+
+**3.3 联合训练对长事件早期编码特征的梯度仍受截断限制。**
+
+每次256个新步，历史feature detach。完整候选常在结束后才产生事件损失，因此长事件的早期表示作为历史输入参与候选判别，却不能接收该候选的编码器梯度。这是当前截断反向传播的实际边界，并非完整端到端定位。
+
+建议增加已经发生部分的事件语义/阶段辅助监督或局部候选辅助判别，让事件中段也获得与最终判别有关的梯度。部分事件不能伪造尚未发生的终点，更不能把前缀标签直接当完整事件IoU标签。对可观测困难片段可在session完成后重新编码少量局部区域，但需重新定义训练成本与身份。
+
+**3.4 共享梯度不均衡已有证据，但不能立即用扩大损失或PCGrad代替诊断。**
+
+epoch14每32个chunk采样的64条诊断中，proposal/state/event/quality加权梯度范数中位数约为0.00915/0.00400/0.0000193/0.000000138。event与proposal范数均>1e-6的55条记录中，28条夹角>90度。
+
+诊断多数落在背景chunk，无法代表正事件上的任务重要性；质量头自身参数梯度也未由这一编码器范数充分描述。应先按正事件、near-miss、背景分层统计梯度、损失、任务头梯度和实际贡献，再决定温和的权重调整。局部起止正监督很稀疏，可评估训练折内正权重或focal监督。PCGrad只作为冲突持续且影响效果时的对照。
+
+对比学习实际并非完全未启用：epoch8/10/12/14均有63/2021个chunk产生有效对比项，每轮记录4262个有效anchor。其覆盖范围很有限；可增加同事件已观测阶段的合法配对，保持跨subject/session/model缓存隔离，并保留关闭对照。
+
+## 4. 验证与选模：分清模型变化和操作点变化
+
+epoch14所选`high_0.2_gap_30、budget10/h`覆盖28/34。但同轮`high_0.06_gap_30、budget20/h`可覆盖33/34，TP20、FP16、F1=0.5714、FP/h=0.06013。模型仍能提出很多真实事件，问题包含预算和最终误报约束下的筛选取舍，而不是候选能力全局崩溃。
+
+建议保留既定完整内部搜索，同时增加固定decoder/预算的诊断曲线，并分别记录：原始proposal覆盖→预算后覆盖→事件判别接受→流式NMS提交→严格匹配TP。固定诊断点必须提前锁定，不能用outer结果倒选。
+
+selector仅34个事件，同手仅13个。epoch12到14同手召回下降对应8个TP降为6个，尚不能认定具体手别编码分支失效。应输出按主体、手别、时长和缺失分层的事件级错误，使用同一事件集合进行配对边界比较，并依靠内部OOF及outer评估验证泛化。
+
+8019个操作点在同一selector上搜索，再选epoch，开发成绩有选择偏差。可在下一协议中评估校准与selector选择进一步cross-fit，或选择邻近阈值稳定的区域；当前run继续以完整内部OOF和outer holdout为正式证据。
+
+当前selector目录主要保存`search.json`和时间特征cache，缺少所选候选/拒绝候选/匹配事件的完整表。训练sample审计也在epoch去重之前计数。需增加实际loss贡献、来源、quality、边界残差和拒绝原因，使“覆盖高但TP少”的损失位置可复核。
+
+## 5. 训练、验证与部署速度
+
+**5.1 来源CDF拟合执行了大量不需要的候选头推理。优先级最高。**
+
+`fit_source_mapping()`调用完整`predict_joint_model()`，对9套decoder生成的全部候选逐个评分，并生成3套Boundary回退结果。CDF只需family/source/scale/raw_score及训练subject身份，不需要event logit、quality或refinement。
+
+应实现专用proposal/source映射路径，保留相同encoder、decoder顺序、family代表选择、CDF结果和数据审计，跳过候选判别与refinement。模型改变后来源分布也会改变，因此不能把epoch8的CDF直接复用到epoch14。
+
+**5.2 逐候选ROI与GPU小调用使现有GPU资源难以利用。**
+
+`score_candidate()`每个候选先扫描历史时间，再逐个构造24个bin的mean/max，执行batch1候选头，随后把两项输出转float产生同步。验证在预算前评分所有候选，9套decoder与大量变体放大成本。Boundary未qualified时仍生成多份回退对象。
+
+建议时间轴二分定位所需区间、缓存完全相同的ROI、批量构造候选输入，并用32/64/128等验证batch做硬件测量。缓存键必须覆盖精确边界、decision time、模型/数据/feature/missing mask身份；输出缓存还必须覆盖metadata。不能仅以family作为复用键。
+
+各预算的联合搜索可先确定其候选并集，只评分会进入至少一个预算的候选；CDF仍使用原来的完整生成分布。正式部署已经先预算后评分，不执行完整8019点搜索。
+
+**5.3 搜索重复做校准、DataFrame构建及匹配。**
+
+每次完整搜索为3 high×3 gap×3 budget×3 NMS×99 acceptance=8019。每个acceptance重新校准同一批候选概率、分组、提交、构造含大量诊断字段的事件DataFrame并计算匹配。
+
+应在每组setting/budget内缓存校准概率、rank score、decision分组、ignore判定、session曝光及候选-truth IoU；匹配时使用保留原规则的最小事件数据结构。并行时恢复原搜索顺序与tie-break，控制进程复制内存。
+
+流式提交是不可撤销的，改变threshold可能改变早期事件对后续事件的抑制关系。不能把低阈值下的最终预测简单过滤来替代其他阈值的流式NMS。不能删搜索范围来声称数值等价加速。
+
+**5.4 断点诊断历史不断增长，完整写盘代价随epoch上升。**
+
+每chunk写时间cache、feature cache及完整resume.pt，并分别flush/fsync；cache binding也重复原子写入。epoch14之后的resume约28MB，每轮2021个chunk，写入量可能达到数十GB量级。这个量级估算不等于实际磁盘吞吐测量。
+
+应把不可变sample/gradient/历史诊断改为带校验的追加日志，checkpoint保留提交位置和恢复所需最小状态。仍保存RNG、模型、optimizer、累计梯度、session状态和cache游标，恢复只接受完整提交chunk。需要维护先日志/缓存持久化、后checkpoint提交的原子协议，不能随意减少安全断点。
+
+**5.5 编码器每256个新步实际计算1137步。**
+
+当前真实geometry为history881、新步256，总1137，即输入步数为新步数的4.44倍。历史来自实际感受野要求，直接缩短会改变模型。
+
+验证可研究增量卷积状态及跨尺度完成块缓存；训练必须同时处理dropout、梯度范围和session内模型身份。改变chunk长度或多session训练batch会改变浮点顺序、dropout RNG和事件梯度截断，不能直接宣称当前run数值等价。
+
+**5.6 实际验证约1小时至近2小时，当前缺乏可靠分段profiling。**
+
+按来源cache首次创建至search保存的文件时间估算：epoch8约110.7分钟，epoch10约56.9分钟，epoch12约101.4分钟，epoch14约99.4分钟。这些包含来源拟合、selector推理和搜索，不是纯GPU验证耗时。epoch14来源拟合段约54.1分钟。
+
+`training_history.elapsed_seconds`从一次训练函数调用起算，且resume重新起算，不是每轮耗时。应新增read/preprocess/H2D/encoder/ROI/head/CDF/search/cache/checkpoint阶段计时、候选吞吐、磁盘量及完整主/worker进程RAM。
+
+训练persistent worker在验证期间仍可能保留，而验证新建另一套10 worker。应共享安全的数据服务或明确释放/复用，按总RAM调整预取；增加worker不等于增加CPU搜索速度。
+
+**5.7 部署速度还需真实长session验证。**
+
+部署只运行锁定的一套decoder、预算、校准及Boundary状态。但`JointRawStream`不断拼接raw数据，`push_features()`不断拼接历史，ROI继续扫描历史，长session存在随长度增长的额外复制和查询成本。
+
+建议采用有身份的增量原始预处理、时间索引和分块历史存储。活跃长事件必须保留其候选所需的完整信息，不能简单丢弃固定长度窗口。前缀一致性、决策时间和wall-clock实时倍率分别验收；数据时间轴延迟≤60秒不能证明墙钟推理达标。
+
+## 6. 推荐实施优先级与当前run兼容性
+
+| 优先级 | 工作 | 主要目标 | 当前run处理 |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| P0 | 专用CDF路径、无资格Boundary跳过、ROI定位和候选批评分 | 减少重复验证推理 | 数值及搜索结果验证通过后受控resume迁移 |
+| P0 | 缓存搜索输入、最小匹配数据、稳定顺序并行 | 缩短8019点搜索 | 同上，保持全部搜索范围与流式匹配规则 |
+| P0 | 逐事件诊断、实际loss贡献、阶段计时和完整RAM | 定位遗漏与可靠估时 | 受控身份变更，避免运行时直接替换源码 |
+| P1 | 诊断追加日志与小checkpoint事务 | 控制每chunk写盘量 | 恢复等价及崩溃测试通过后受控迁移 |
+| P1 | onset参与解码、边界训练/启用门禁分离、family组内质量监督 | 改善提前起点与判别质量 | 新配置、新协议身份、新run |
+| P1 | 事件/主体贡献归一化、局部事件辅助监督、梯度分层 | 提升共享训练有效性 | 新run，保留当前run作为对照 |
+| P2 | 增量encoder和raw处理、多session吞吐实验 | 长session和训练加速 | 先验证数值/前缀/训练语义；无法等价时新run |
+| P2 | PCGrad、额外容量或更复杂主干 | 仅用于已证实的剩余瓶颈 | 消融后决定，不作为首选 |
+
+性能优化验收应同时核对：source CDF、所有操作点记录及最佳点、逐事件身份/边界、严格匹配、门禁、前缀一致性、同checkpoint重复误差≤1e-6，以及resume后的RNG/optimizer/累计梯度。涉及训练路径时，还需验证loss、参数梯度及后续optimizer更新。batch数值微差若改变阈值/NMS结果，不属于已证明的无影响加速。
+
+算法修改验收应使用同一subject split、seed2026、合法内部OOF和独立outer评估；增加配对起止MAE、FP来源、正事件分层和候选漏斗。不能仅凭新的搜索后selector F1判定改动有效。
+
+本报告不承诺F1、MAE或端到端速度提升比例。最值得优先实施的是无需改变科学协议的重复计算消除；模型效果优化则先解决已确认的监督与解码脱节，再考虑增加容量。

+# v4.11 共享编码器、学习定位与联合判别
+

+

+
+|字段|值|
+|---|---|
+|architecture|statsfusion_joint_event_v411|
+|protocol|statsfusion-joint-event-v2|
+|schema|v411|
+|seed|2026|
+|config|configs/statsfusion_v411_learned_boundary.yaml|

+
+## 模型与因果语义
+
+共享编码器保留隐藏维度64以及原传感器、质量、统计和缺失分支；3/15/60秒 proposal 路径只聚合已完成块。候选头包含24个全事件ROI token和起止各8个局部token，共40个，五个区域embedding。候选头输出事件logit、质量logit与64维embedding。Boundary输入为local64、candidate64、relative/validity/onset/offset共132维，MLP132→64→2。
+
+occupancy仍负责活动区间。已确认的onset峰阈值0.30、左右各9秒，较早同值峰优先；起点±900秒内保留两个最高峰，间隔至少15秒。每个父proposal最多粗版本加两个学习版本；无峰时才补最多两个兼容版本。几何去重合并source flags。`no_onset`消融保留完整兼容池。
+
+CDF按训练受试者上的父来源与尺度冻结；版本共享父分数。预算为累计有效曝光下允许进入候选头的唯一几何，先分配不同粗父proposal，再补版本。主线没有强制来源配额，仍记录来源与缺额。Boundary重评分的额外调用另计。
+
+接受分数固定为非负Platt校准的事件概率，v411的rank_score等于该概率。已接受的同父版本先比较质量、Boundary置信度、事件概率、稳定ID；跨父版本按概率、质量、ID执行流式NMS。family不强制只能输出一个事件。所有最终输入早于decision；提交后不可撤销；decision与报告终点相差不超过60秒。
+
+这是离散候选坐标和历史detach下的截断联合训练，不能称为完全可微定位。
+
+## 训练与OOF
+
+每chunk256个新步、实际感受野warmup、串行session、累计4个session。session内权重固定。CPU/memmap历史特征detach；当前chunk保持梯度。每chunk最多8组，配额2正、2near-miss、3hard-FP、1background；每组最多3个不同几何。正事件每epoch最多3组，组内版本平均，CPU梯度缓冲在session结束时按实际组数和独立事件数平均。负family重复受控。每个版本、每次refine均重新计算严格IoU>0.25标签。质量排序仅在IoU差至少0.10时参与，权重0.05。
+
+配额由`training.group_quotas`显式注册，v411拒绝旧`sample_composition`及未注册的组数、版本数配置。同一粗父proposal的版本若匹配不同真实正事件，按真实事件拆分监督组，分别计数和归一化。Boundary逐端点判断是否已经观测及实际有效支持是否覆盖；未出现的终点不会阻止合法起点监督。
+
+State/proposal/起止/event/quality/Boundary/smooth/contrastive权重依次0.5/1/0.1/1/0.5/0.1/0.02/0.003。对比学习第6轮启用，历史正对detach，排除ignore、边界±30秒以及同事件其他阶段伪负；无合法正负对返回零。优化器、AMP、最大32轮、clipping与早停门禁保持既有协议。
+
+Boundary从第3轮学习，不要求fit分区达到60事件；严格正候选、端点已出现、支持范围覆盖且有效bin至少3才监督。正式启用独立依赖完整内部OOF：off/start_only/both。先锁粗proposal、预算、NMS；每种修正模式独立自然校准，entropy三值×99接受阈值，始终比较原锁定粗基线。start_only保证终点不变。启用要求至少60独立配对事件、相应端点MAE改善10%、F1下降≤0.005、TP损失≤1%、clipping≤5%。报告分母与精确95%区间；零失败不证明真实风险≤1%。
+
+五折沿用既有subject split。每折3内部排除分区，每个分区35%selector选模，再从头retrain；outer标签不参与选择。局部消融固定fold0/internal0，分别从头训练no_onset、no_boundary、single_candidate，仅作开发诊断。
+
+## 验证、速度与恢复
+
+来源CDF专用路径不调用候选头或Boundary。ROI采用二分时间索引与精确缓存；metadata始终重新进入候选头。验证batch128，在9个decoder与3个预算的入选并集上评分。缓存ignore、IoU矩阵、校准概率和decision分组；最多4进程按注册顺序归并全部8019个粗操作点，各阈值独立执行流式NMS。
+
+训练历史不拼接复制完整137维session；使用分块视图与memmap。sampling/gradients/candidate_history/training_history写入链式SHA256追加日志。恢复按checkpoint记录的字节游标校验并截断未提交尾部。每chunk先fsync缓存、日志，再原子提交RNG、optimizer、累计梯度、正事件缓冲和session游标。worker池在验证前与异常退出时释放。
+
+worker10、prefetch4、reader cache4；resume只允许这三个运行参数变化。模型、损失、数据、源码与协议变化必须新run，无v410式迁移。GPU峰值限制10.5GB，进程树private RAM限制26GB，超限失败。执行日志包含时间、资源、worker、写盘量、吞吐及head调用。
+
+流式入口暂存每次非final调用最后一个anchor的候选决策，收到下一anchor时在增加新曝光前完成它，或在空final调用时与EOF候选一起决策。这样最后一个非空chunk直接final与后续空chunk final共用相同预算和NMS顺序；评分始终受原decision time遮罩。调用方必须发送final以完成最后一组候选提交。已提交事件及其嵌套来源信息保存独立副本。
+
+完整验证2倍加速是待测目标，不是已证实结果。`scripts/benchmark_statsfusion_v411.py`对同一v411 checkpoint和受排除subject运行参考与优化路径，保留完整搜索，核对全部操作点匹配与资格，再保存耗时报告。参数为`--checkpoint --subjects <JSON受试者列表> --output <全新目录>`；使用配置中的device并检查GPU空闲。尚无已训练v411 checkpoint时不能给出真实完整验证加速倍数。
+
+## 门禁与产物
+
+正式门禁保持F1≥0.5475、FP/h≤0.0609237、覆盖≥125/161且各折≥0.70，以及手别、bootstrap、matching和stress要求。优先只读审计已完成v410五折的completion、checkpoint、内部OOF、校准、cohort与曝光；不要求参考先通过其旧晋级门禁。参考不完整时只允许诊断，不能导出。S0显式跳过，comparison_performed=false。
+
+门禁失败写failure_report并保留诊断，隔离任何部署bundle。正式导出必须通过五折锁、专用部署内部OOF与Boundary模式锁，最终从头训练。验收分为实现验证、五折诊断与正式晋级三种不同状态。
+
+## 执行
+
+在本隔离目录中，等当前v410释放GPU后执行：
+
+```powershell
+$config = "configs/statsfusion_v411_learned_boundary.yaml"
+$run = "statsfusion_v411_learned_boundary_20261008a"
+$reference = "statsfusion_v410_joint_event_20261007a"
+conda run -n bme-model python scripts/run_statsfusion_joint.py `
+  --config $config --run-name $run --stage all `
+  --skip-s0 --reference-run $reference --fresh
+```
+
+中断后仅把`--fresh`改为`--resume`。all执行audit→validate→outer→ablation→gates→final→export→replay。若GPU忙，状态落为PAUSED，待资源空闲使用resume。
+
+CPU测试应设置本目录src为PYTHONPATH，避免可编辑安装指向旧项目。隐藏GPU后执行pytest、ruff、compileall及diff检查；GPU bfloat16、真实session资源、真实完整验证速度和正式bundle replay需在资源释放且相应产物存在时执行，不可把synthetic测试等同正式性能。
+
+pytest配置已设置本目录`src`优先。资源释放后可设置`$env:BME_V410_RESOURCE_TESTS="1"`，运行`tests/test_statsfusion_joint_resources.py`；该兼容开关现同时覆盖v410和v411配置。2026-10-08深度审计记录见`docs/statsfusion_v411_deep_audit_20261008.md`。

+from __future__ import annotations

+import argparse

+
+
+def main():
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Compare identical v411 checkpoint and complete search")
+    parser.add_argument("--config", default=str(PROJECT_ROOT / "configs/statsfusion_v411_learned_boundary.yaml"))
+    parser.add_argument("--checkpoint", required=True)
+    parser.add_argument("--subjects", required=True, help="JSON list of excluded selector or OOF subjects")
+    parser.add_argument("--output", required=True)
+    arguments = parser.parse_args()
+    config = load_config(arguments.config)
+    _load_project_dotenv(config)
+    require_idle_gpu(config["training"]["device"])
+    output = Path(arguments.output)
+    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
+    payload = torch.load(arguments.checkpoint, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
+    if payload["config_sha256"] != config_identity(config):
+        raise RuntimeError("Benchmark configuration differs from checkpoint")
+    subjects = set(json.loads(Path(arguments.subjects).read_text(encoding="utf-8")))
+    training = set(payload["training_subjects"])
+    if not subjects or subjects & training or not subjects.issubset(set(payload["excluded_subjects"])):
+        raise RuntimeError("Benchmark subjects must be explicitly excluded from training")
+    base = require_environment_path(config, "output_root_env")
+    inputs = JointInputs.audit(base / config["project"]["input_artifact_schema_version"],
+                               base / config["project"]["canonical_schema_version"])
+    if payload["data_sha256"] != digest(inputs.identity):
+        raise RuntimeError("Benchmark data differs from checkpoint")
+    model = build_joint_model(config).to(config["training"]["device"]).eval()
+    model.load_state_dict(payload["model"])
+    mapping = fit_source_mapping(model, inputs, training, config, payload["preprocessing"],
+                                 output / "source_fit", payload["identity"])
+    _, _, events, _ = inputs.frames(subjects, labels=True)
+    truth, ignore = partition_evaluation_events(events, subjects)
+    reports, registered = {}, None
+    for name, reference in (("reference", True), ("optimized", False)):
+        current = copy.deepcopy(config)
+        current["_reference_execution"] = reference
+        started = time.monotonic()
+        predictions = predict_joint_model(model, inputs, subjects, current, payload["preprocessing"],
+            output / name, payload["identity"], payload["boundary"], mapping=mapping)
+        point, records = choose_operating_point(predictions["coarse"], predictions["windows"], truth,
+                                               ignore, {payload["identity"]: mapping}, current)
+        report = {"elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started, "point": point,
+                  "registered_operating_points": len(records), "prediction": predictions["performance"]}
+        scores = [{key: record[key] for key in ("setting", "budget", "nms", "acceptance", "true_positive",
+                  "false_positive", "false_negative", "promotion_eligible")} for record in records]
+        if registered is not None and registered != scores:
+            raise RuntimeError("Optimization changed matching, operating points or gate qualification")
+        registered = scores
+        reports[name] = report
+    speedup = reports["reference"]["elapsed_seconds"] / reports["optimized"]["elapsed_seconds"]
+    write_json_atomic(output / "benchmark.json", {"checkpoint_sha256": sha256_file(arguments.checkpoint),
+        "reports": reports, "full_validation_speedup": speedup, "target_2x_met": speedup >= 2,
+        "search_reduced": False, "device": config["training"]["device"]})
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    main()

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+
+from bme_eating.hierarchical_artifacts import sha256_file, write_json_atomic
+from bme_eating.joint_protocol import digest
+from bme_eating.training.hierarchical_v4_trainer import _selector_split, stacking_partitions
+from bme_eating.training.statsfusion_joint_trainer import train_joint_model
+
+
+def execute_ablations(inputs, config, run, resume):
+    outer = {subject for subject, fold in inputs.subject_folds.items() if fold == 0}
+    subjects = set(inputs.subject_folds) - outer
+    partitions = stacking_partitions(subjects, 3, 2026)
+    prediction = {subject for subject, partition in partitions.items() if partition == 0}
+    training = subjects - prediction
+    anchors, _, events, _ = inputs.frames(training, labels=True)
+    fit, selector, report = _selector_split(training, .35, 2026, events=events, anchors=anchors)
+    results = []
+    for name in ("no_onset", "no_boundary", "single_candidate"):
+        ablation = copy.deepcopy(config)
+        ablation["ablation"] = {"name": name, "diagnostic_only": True, "fold": 0, "partition": 0}
+        ablation["decoder"]["ablation"] = name
+        directory = run / "ablations" / name
+        identity = digest({"run": sha256_file(run / "identity.json"), "ablation": name,
+                           "fit": sorted(fit), "selector": sorted(selector), "excluded": sorted(outer | prediction)})
+        write_json_atomic(directory / "resolved_config.json", ablation)
+        write_json_atomic(directory / "selector_split.json", report)
+        epoch = train_joint_model(inputs, fit, ablation, directory / "selection", identity,
+            epochs=ablation["training"]["max_epochs"], resume=resume, selector=selector,
+            outer_excluded=outer | prediction)
+        results.append({"name": name, "epoch": epoch, "identity": identity,
+                        "diagnostic_only": True, "automatic_main_selection": False,
+                        "fit_subjects": sorted(fit), "selector_subjects": sorted(selector)})
+    write_json_atomic(run / "ablation_manifest.json", results)
+    return results

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+
+import numpy as np
+
+from bme_eating.joint_evaluation import (
+    NonnegativePlatt,
+    calibration_ece,
+    commit_candidates,
+    event_frame,
+)
+from bme_eating.joint_stream import candidate_targets
+from bme_eating.metrics import prediction_ignore_mask
+
+
+def refined_key(point):
+    if point.get("boundary_mode"):
+        return f"{point['boundary_mode']}:{point['boundary_entropy']}"
+    return str(point["boundary_entropy"])
+
+
+def lock_boundary_modes(coarse_point, natural, coarse_predictions, outputs, truth, ignore, windows, config):
+    from bme_eating.training.statsfusion_joint_trainer import boundary_pair_gate
+    locked = copy.deepcopy(coarse_point)
+    point = {**copy.deepcopy(locked), "boundary_mode": "off", "boundary_enabled": False,
+             "boundary_entropy": None}
+    reports, search, best = [], [], None
+    thresholds = np.arange(config["search"]["acceptance_min"], config["search"]["acceptance_max"] + 1e-8,
+                           config["search"]["acceptance_step"])
+    for mode in ("start_only", "both"):
+        for entropy in config["boundary"]["entropy_thresholds"]:
+            versions = {item.proposal_id: item for output in outputs for item in
+                        output["refined"][f"{mode}:{entropy}"][locked["setting"]]}
+            refined = [versions[item.proposal_id] for item in natural]
+            labels = np.asarray([candidate_targets(item, truth)[0] for item in refined])
+            ignored = prediction_ignore_mask(event_frame(refined), ignore)
+            keep = ~ignored | (labels > 0)
+            logits = np.asarray([item.event_logit for item in refined])
+            calibrator = NonnegativePlatt.fit(logits[keep], labels[keep])
+            ece = calibration_ece(calibrator.transform(logits[keep]), labels[keep], config["calibration"]["bins"])
+            mode_best, mode_report = None, None
+            for acceptance in thresholds:
+                prediction, diagnostics = commit_candidates(copy.deepcopy(refined), calibrator,
+                    float(acceptance), locked["nms"], return_diagnostics=True)
+                report = boundary_pair_gate(coarse_predictions, prediction, truth, ignore, windows,
+                    config, refined_candidates=diagnostics, mode=mode)
+                metrics = report["refined"]
+                eligible = (locked["promotion_eligible"] and report["passed"] and calibrator.qualified
+                    and ece <= config["calibration"]["maximum_ece"]
+                    and metrics["fp_per_hour"] <= config["gates"]["maximum_fp_per_hour"])
+                record = {"boundary_mode": mode, "entropy": entropy, "acceptance": float(acceptance),
+                          "nms": locked["nms"], "promotion_eligible": bool(eligible),
+                          "calibration_ece": ece, **metrics}
+                search.append(record)
+                key = (int(eligible), metrics["f1"], -metrics["fp_per_hour"])
+                if mode_best is None or key > mode_best:
+                    mode_best, mode_report = key, {**report, "entropy": entropy, "acceptance": float(acceptance),
+                        "calibration": calibrator.to_json(), "calibration_ece": ece,
+                        "locked_coarse_calibration": locked["calibration"], "passed": bool(eligible)}
+                if eligible and (best is None or key > best):
+                    best = key
+                    point = {**locked, **metrics, "boundary_mode": mode, "boundary_enabled": True,
+                        "boundary_entropy": entropy, "acceptance": float(acceptance),
+                        "calibration": calibrator.to_json(), "calibration_ece": ece,
+                        "promotion_eligible": True}
+            reports.append(mode_report)
+    point["coarse_operating_point"] = locked
+    point["score_formula"] = "calibrated_event_probability_v411"
+    return point, reports, search

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from collections import OrderedDict
+
+import torch
+
+
+class FeatureBlocks:
+    def __init__(self, blocks, width=137):
+        self.blocks = [block for block in blocks if len(block)]
+        self.shape = (sum(len(block) for block in self.blocks), width)
+
+    def __len__(self):
+        return self.shape[0]
+
+    def __getitem__(self, selection):
+        rows, columns = selection if isinstance(selection, tuple) else (selection, slice(None))
+        outputs, offset = [], 0
+        if isinstance(rows, torch.Tensor) and rows.dtype == torch.bool:
+            for block in self.blocks:
+                outputs.append(block[rows[offset:offset + len(block)], columns])
+                offset += len(block)
+        elif isinstance(rows, slice):
+            start, stop, step = rows.indices(len(self))
+            if step != 1:
+                raise ValueError("Blocked history requires contiguous indexed slices")
+            for block in self.blocks:
+                first, last = max(0, start - offset), min(len(block), stop - offset)
+                if first < last:
+                    outputs.append(block[first:last, columns])
+                offset += len(block)
+        else:
+            raise TypeError("Blocked history requires slice or Boolean mask")
+        if outputs:
+            return torch.cat(outputs)
+        width = torch.empty(0, self.shape[1])[:, columns].shape
+        return torch.empty(width)
+
+
+class BlockedHistory:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.time_blocks, self.feature_blocks = [], []
+
+    def append(self, times, features):
+        self.time_blocks.append(times.cpu())
+        self.feature_blocks.append(features.cpu())
+
+    @property
+    def times(self):
+        return torch.cat(self.time_blocks) if self.time_blocks else torch.empty(0, dtype=torch.int64)
+
+    @property
+    def features(self):
+        return FeatureBlocks(self.feature_blocks)
+
+
+class ExactROICache:
+    def __init__(self, binding, maximum=1024):
+        self.binding, self.maximum = binding, maximum
+        self.values = OrderedDict()
+        self.hits, self.misses = 0, 0
+
+    def key(self, candidate):
+        return (self.binding, candidate.model_identity, candidate.subject_key, candidate.session_id,
+                candidate.start_ms, candidate.end_ms, candidate.decision_time_ms,
+                candidate.max_input_time_ms)
+
+    def get(self, candidate):
+        key = self.key(candidate)
+        if key not in self.values:
+            self.misses += 1
+            return None
+        self.hits += 1
+        self.values.move_to_end(key)
+        return self.values[key]
+
+    def put(self, candidate, roi):
+        if roi.requires_grad:
+            raise RuntimeError("Training ROI cannot be cached across backward graphs")
+        self.values[self.key(candidate)] = roi
+        while len(self.values) > self.maximum:
+            self.values.popitem(last=False)

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import os
+
+
+class CheckedJournal:
+    def __init__(self, path, committed_bytes=0):
+        self.path, self.offset, self.previous = path, committed_bytes, ""
+        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        if not path.exists():
+            path.touch()
+        if path.stat().st_size < committed_bytes:
+            raise RuntimeError("Committed diagnostic log is truncated")
+        with path.open("r+b") as handle:
+            while handle.tell() < committed_bytes:
+                line = handle.readline()
+                if not line.endswith(b"\n") or handle.tell() > committed_bytes:
+                    raise RuntimeError("Committed log ends inside a record")
+                record = json.loads(line)
+                encoded = json.dumps(record["payload"], sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
+                                     ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
+                checksum = hashlib.sha256(self.previous.encode() + encoded).hexdigest()
+                if record["sha256"] != checksum:
+                    raise RuntimeError("Diagnostic log checksum mismatch")
+                self.previous = checksum
+            handle.truncate(committed_bytes)
+
+    def append(self, payloads):
+        with self.path.open("ab") as handle:
+            for payload in payloads:
+                encoded = json.dumps(payload, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"),
+                                     ensure_ascii=False).encode("utf-8")
+                self.previous = hashlib.sha256(self.previous.encode() + encoded).hexdigest()
+                line = json.dumps({"payload": payload, "sha256": self.previous},
+                                  ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n"
+                handle.write(line.encode("utf-8"))
+            handle.flush()
+            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+            self.offset = handle.tell()
+
+    def records(self):
+        with self.path.open("rb") as handle:
+            while handle.tell() < self.offset:
+                yield json.loads(handle.readline())["payload"]

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import time
+
+import pandas as pd
+import torch
+
+from bme_eating.data.joint_sessions import (
+    SessionChunkSampler,
+    make_joint_dataset,
+    release_session_loader,
+    session_loader,
+)
+from bme_eating.hierarchical_artifacts import write_json_atomic
+from bme_eating.joint_stream import FrozenSourceCDF, OnlineBudget, TimelineCache, stable_id
+from bme_eating.joint_v411_features import ExactROICache
+from bme_eating.joint_v411_scoring import refine, score_candidates
+from bme_eating.joint_v411_stream import make_stream
+
+
+@torch.no_grad()
+def predict(model, inputs, subjects, config, preprocessing, directory, identity, boundary,
+            *, source_only=False, mapping=None):
+    from bme_eating.training.statsfusion_joint_trainer import (
+        decoder_settings,
+        enforce_resources,
+        pack_features,
+    )
+    directory.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+    started = time.monotonic()
+    device = next(model.parameters()).device
+    dataset, _ = make_joint_dataset(inputs, subjects, config, preprocessing, training=source_only)
+    dataset.training = False
+    sampler = SessionChunkSampler(dataset, 0, training=False)
+    loader = session_loader(dataset, sampler, config)
+    model.eval()
+    reference_execution = config.get("_reference_execution", False)
+    head_batch = 1 if reference_execution else config["training"]["validation_head_batch_size"]
+    settings = decoder_settings(config)
+    coarse = {name: [] for name in settings}
+    refined = {f"{mode}:{entropy}": {name: [] for name in settings}
+               for mode in ("start_only", "both") for entropy in config["boundary"]["entropy_thresholds"]}
+    windows, current_key, streams, trackers = [], None, {}, {}
+    counters = {"head_calls": 0, "boundary_rescore_calls": 0, "parent_proposals": 0,
+                "generated_geometries": 0, "admitted_geometries": 0,
+                "roi_hits": 0, "roi_misses": 0, "cache_write_bytes": 0,
+                "encoder_seconds": 0.0, "proposal_seconds": 0.0, "head_seconds": 0.0}
+    try:
+        for chunk_index, batch in enumerate(loader):
+            _, _, _, key, last, count = sampler.chunks[chunk_index]
+            if hasattr(inputs, "assert_session_unchanged"):
+                inputs.assert_session_unchanged(key)
+            if key != current_key:
+                current_key = key
+                streams = {name: make_stream(*key, identity, decoder) for name, decoder in settings.items()}
+                trackers = {name: {budget: OnlineBudget(budget, {}) for budget in config["search"]["budgets"]}
+                            for name in settings}
+                cache = TimelineCache(directory / "cache" / stable_id(*key),
+                    {"identity": identity, "epoch": "prediction", "subject": key[0], "session": key[1]}, 137)
+                roi_cache = ExactROICache((identity, key))
+            batch = {name: value.to(device) if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor) else value for name, value in batch.items()}
+            stage = time.monotonic()
+            outputs = model(batch)
+            mask = torch.zeros(batch["timestamp_ms"].shape[1], dtype=torch.bool, device=device)
+            mask[-count:] = True
+            times, features = batch["timestamp_ms"][0, mask].cpu(), pack_features(outputs, mask).cpu()
+            counters["encoder_seconds"] += time.monotonic() - stage
+            if not source_only:
+                cache.append(times.numpy(), features.numpy())
+                all_times, all_features = cache.tensors()
+                counters["cache_write_bytes"] += len(times) * (8 + 137 * 4)
+            for timestamp, values in zip(times.tolist(), features.numpy()):
+                windows.append({"subject_key": key[0], "session_id": key[1], "timestamp_ms": timestamp,
+                                "valid": float(values[128]), "gyro_valid": float(values[135]), "model_identity": identity})
+            stage = time.monotonic()
+            generated = {name: [] for name in settings}
+            for name, stream in streams.items():
+                for timestamp, values in zip(times.tolist(), features.numpy()):
+                    for tracker in trackers[name].values():
+                        tracker.observe(3, float(values[128]))
+                    probabilities = {"state": float(values[129]), **{f"proposal_{scale}": float(values[130 + index])
+                                      for index, scale in enumerate((3, 15, 60))}}
+                    pool = stream.observe(timestamp, probabilities, float(values[128]), float(values[134]),
+                                          onset_probability=float(values[133]))
+                    if last and timestamp == int(times[-1]):
+                        pool.extend(stream.finish())
+                    counters["parent_proposals"] += len({item.ancestor_id for item in pool})
+                    counters["generated_geometries"] += len(pool)
+                    if source_only:
+                        generated[name].extend(item for item in pool if item.source in {"state", "proposal"})
+                    else:
+                        if mapping is None:
+                            raise RuntimeError("v411 prediction requires a training-fitted source CDF")
+                        union = {}
+                        for tracker in trackers[name].values():
+                            for item in tracker.select(copy.deepcopy(pool), mapping) if pool else []:
+                                union[item.proposal_id] = item
+                        generated[name].extend(pool if reference_execution else union.values())
+            counters["proposal_seconds"] += time.monotonic() - stage
+            if source_only:
+                for name, pool in generated.items():
+                    coarse[name].extend(pool)
+            else:
+                stage = time.monotonic()
+                for name, pool in generated.items():
+                    scores = score_candidates(model, pool, all_times, all_features, device,
+                        batch_size=head_batch, cache=None if reference_execution else roi_cache)
+                    counters["head_calls"] += (len(pool) + head_batch - 1) // head_batch
+                    counters["admitted_geometries"] += len(pool)
+                    coarse[name].extend(pool)
+                    for mode in ("start_only", "both"):
+                        for entropy in config["boundary"]["entropy_thresholds"]:
+                            versions = [refine(model, item, all_times, all_features, device,
+                                {**boundary, "mode": mode}, entropy, embedding=score["candidate_embedding"][0],
+                                rescore=False) for item, score in zip(pool, scores)]
+                            changed = [item for item in versions if item.refined]
+                            score_candidates(model, changed, all_times, all_features, device,
+                                batch_size=head_batch, cache=None if reference_execution else roi_cache)
+                            counters["boundary_rescore_calls"] += (len(changed) + head_batch - 1) // head_batch
+                            refined[f"{mode}:{entropy}"][name].extend(versions)
+                counters["head_seconds"] += time.monotonic() - stage
+                counters["roi_hits"], counters["roi_misses"] = roi_cache.hits, roi_cache.misses
+            usage = enforce_resources(config, device)
+            if hasattr(inputs, "assert_session_unchanged"):
+                inputs.assert_session_unchanged(key)
+        counters.update({"elapsed_seconds": time.monotonic() - started, "source_only": source_only,
+                         "candidate_throughput_per_second": counters["admitted_geometries"] /
+                         max(time.monotonic() - started, 1e-9), **usage})
+        write_json_atomic(directory / "performance.json", counters)
+        return {"coarse": coarse, "refined": refined, "windows": pd.DataFrame(windows), "performance": counters}
+    finally:
+        release_session_loader(loader)
+
+
+def fit_mapping(model, inputs, subjects, config, preprocessing, directory, identity):
+    outputs = predict(model, inputs, subjects, config, preprocessing, directory, identity,
+                       {}, source_only=True)
+    mapping = FrozenSourceCDF.fit([item for pool in outputs["coarse"].values() for item in pool], subjects)
+    write_json_atomic(directory / "source_mapping.json", mapping.to_json())
+    return mapping

+def audit_completed_joint(reference_root, inputs):

+    identity = read(reference_root / "identity.json")
+    from bme_eating.joint_resume_migration import active_resume_identity, migration_evidence

+    evidence.update(migration_evidence(reference_root))

+    predictions, windows, truths, ignores, candidates, lineages, calibrations, budgets = [], [], [], [], [], [], [], []

+            raise RuntimeError("Reference fold completion identity mismatch")

+        payload = torch.load(directory / "model" / "latest.pt", map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
+        if (not checkpoint_qualified(payload, report["identity"], train, 8)
+                or set(payload["excluded_subjects"]) != holdout
+                or payload["data_sha256"] != digest(inputs.identity)
+                or payload["config_sha256"] != identity["config_sha256"]
+                or payload["source_sha256"] != digest(identity["source"])
+                or set(payload.get("preprocessing", {}).get("training_subjects", [])) != train):
+            raise RuntimeError("Reference training checkpoint qualification failed")
+        point = report["operating_point"]
+        if not point["calibration"]["qualified"] or point["calibration"]["slope"] < 0:
+            raise RuntimeError("Reference natural calibration is unqualified")
+        internal = read(directory / "internal" / "internal_manifest.json")
+        verify_artifact_hashes(directory / "internal", internal["evidence_sha256"])
+        if read(directory / "internal" / "operating_point.json") != point:
+            raise RuntimeError("Reference operating point differs from internal OOF lock")
+        verify_oof_lineage(point["lineage"], train, holdout, identities={
+            "data_sha256": payload["data_sha256"], "config_sha256": payload["config_sha256"],
+            "source_sha256": payload["source_sha256"]})
+        for lineage in point["lineage"]:
+            checkpoint = torch.load(directory / "internal" / f"partition_{lineage['partition']}" /
+                                    "retrain" / "latest.pt", map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
+            if (not checkpoint_qualified(checkpoint, lineage["model_identity"],
+                                          set(lineage["training_subjects"]), 8)
+                    or set(checkpoint["excluded_subjects"]) != holdout | set(lineage["prediction_subjects"])
+                    or set(checkpoint.get("preprocessing", {}).get("training_subjects", [])) != set(lineage["training_subjects"])
+                    or checkpoint.get("epoch") != lineage["epoch"]
+                    or any(checkpoint.get(name) != payload[name] for name in
+                           ("source_sha256", "config_sha256", "data_sha256"))):
+                raise RuntimeError("Reference internal checkpoint exclusion failed")
+            selector_name = "selected.pt" if lineage.get("selector_promotion_eligible") else "diagnostic_selected.pt"
+            selected = torch.load(directory / "internal" / f"partition_{lineage['partition']}" /
+                                  "selection" / selector_name, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True)
+            selector_fit = set(lineage["selector_fit_subjects"])
+            selector = set(lineage["selector_subjects"])
+            if (not checkpoint_qualified({**selected, "promotion_eligible": True}, lineage["model_identity"], selector_fit, 8)
+                    or set(selected["excluded_subjects"]) != holdout | set(lineage["prediction_subjects"]) | selector
+                    or set(selected.get("preprocessing", {}).get("training_subjects", [])) != selector_fit
+                    or selected["epoch"] != lineage["epoch"]
+                    or bool(selected.get("promotion_eligible")) != bool(lineage.get("selector_promotion_eligible"))
+                    or any(selected.get(name) != payload[name] for name in
+                           ("source_sha256", "config_sha256", "data_sha256"))):
+                raise RuntimeError("Reference selector exclusion or qualification failed")
+        for name, target in (("outer_predictions.parquet", predictions), ("outer_windows.parquet", windows),
+                             ("truth.parquet", truths), ("ignore.parquet", ignores),
+                             ("outer_candidates.parquet", candidates)):
+            frame = pd.read_parquet(directory / name)
+            if len(frame) and not set(frame.subject_key.astype(str)).issubset(holdout):
+                raise RuntimeError("Reference prediction cohort leaks across folds")
+            target.append(frame)
+        from bme_eating.metrics import interval_iou_matrix
+        for (subject, session), target in truths[-1].groupby(["subject_key", "session_id"]):
+            pool = candidates[-1][candidates[-1].subject_key.astype(str).eq(str(subject))
+                                   & candidates[-1].session_id.astype(str).eq(str(session))]
+            covered += int((interval_iou_matrix(target[["start_ms", "end_ms"]].to_numpy(),
+                                                pool[["start_ms", "end_ms"]].to_numpy()) > .25).any(1).sum())
+        lineages.append({"fold": fold, "training_subjects": sorted(train), "prediction_subjects": sorted(holdout)})
+        calibrations.append({**lineages[-1], "oof_lineages": point["lineage"]})
+        budgets.append(point["budget"])
+        evidence[f"fold_{fold}/completion.json"] = sha256_file(directory / "completion.json")
+        evidence.update({f"fold_{fold}/{relative}": checksum for relative, checksum in completion["evidence_sha256"].items()})
+        evidence.update({f"fold_{fold}/internal/{relative}": checksum for relative, checksum in internal["evidence_sha256"].items()})
+    predictions, windows, truths, ignores, candidates = [pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
+                                                       for frames in (predictions, windows, truths, ignores, candidates)]
+    if windows.duplicated(["subject_key", "session_id", "timestamp_ms"]).any():
+        raise RuntimeError("Reference has duplicated outer exposure")
+    if set(windows.subject_key.astype(str)) != subjects:
+        raise RuntimeError("Reference is missing outer subject exposure")
+    return {"qualified": True, "comparison_performed": False, "reasons": [],
+        "root": str(reference_root.resolve()), "evidence_sha256": evidence,
+        "derived_from_five_fold_completions": True,
+        "payload": {"truth_sha256": digest(truths.to_dict("records")),
+                    "ignore_sha256": digest(ignores.to_dict("records")),
+                    "candidate_budget": budgets[0] if len(set(budgets)) == 1 else None,
+                    "candidate_covered": covered,
+                    "model_lineages": lineages, "calibration_lineage": calibrations}}

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import ctypes
+import os
+from ctypes import wintypes
+
+_peak_private = 0.0
+
+
+def private_process_tree():
+    global _peak_private
+    if os.name != "nt":
+        import psutil
+        process = psutil.Process()
+        members = [process, *process.children(recursive=True)]
+        private = sum(member.memory_full_info().uss for member in members)
+        count = len(members)
+    else:
+        class ProcessEntry(ctypes.Structure):
+            _fields_ = [("size", wintypes.DWORD), ("usage", wintypes.DWORD),
+                        ("pid", wintypes.DWORD), ("heap", ctypes.c_size_t),
+                        ("module", wintypes.DWORD), ("threads", wintypes.DWORD),
+                        ("parent", wintypes.DWORD), ("priority", wintypes.LONG),
+                        ("flags", wintypes.DWORD), ("name", wintypes.WCHAR * 260)]
+        class Counters(ctypes.Structure):
+            _fields_ = [("size", wintypes.DWORD), ("faults", wintypes.DWORD),
+                        *[(name, ctypes.c_size_t) for name in (
+                            "peak_working", "working", "peak_paged", "paged", "peak_nonpaged",
+                            "nonpaged", "pagefile", "peak_pagefile", "private")]]
+        kernel = ctypes.WinDLL("kernel32", use_last_error=True)
+        psapi = ctypes.WinDLL("psapi", use_last_error=True)
+        kernel.CreateToolhelp32Snapshot.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
+        kernel.CreateToolhelp32Snapshot.argtypes = [wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.DWORD]
+        kernel.Process32FirstW.argtypes = kernel.Process32NextW.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.POINTER(ProcessEntry)]
+        kernel.OpenProcess.argtypes = [wintypes.DWORD, wintypes.BOOL, wintypes.DWORD]
+        kernel.OpenProcess.restype = wintypes.HANDLE
+        kernel.CloseHandle.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE]
+        psapi.GetProcessMemoryInfo.argtypes = [wintypes.HANDLE, ctypes.POINTER(Counters), wintypes.DWORD]
+        snapshot = kernel.CreateToolhelp32Snapshot(2, 0)
+        if snapshot == ctypes.c_void_p(-1).value:
+            raise RuntimeError("Cannot inspect process tree private RAM")
+        parents, entry = {}, ProcessEntry()
+        entry.size = ctypes.sizeof(entry)
+        try:
+            available = kernel.Process32FirstW(snapshot, ctypes.byref(entry))
+            while available:
+                parents[entry.pid] = entry.parent
+                available = kernel.Process32NextW(snapshot, ctypes.byref(entry))
+        finally:
+            kernel.CloseHandle(snapshot)
+        members = {os.getpid()}
+        while True:
+            extended = members | {pid for pid, parent in parents.items() if parent in members}
+            if members == extended:
+                break
+            members = extended
+        private, count = 0, len(members)
+        for pid in members:
+            process = kernel.OpenProcess(0x410, False, pid)
+            if not process:
+                continue
+            counters = Counters()
+            counters.size = ctypes.sizeof(counters)
+            try:
+                if not psapi.GetProcessMemoryInfo(process, ctypes.byref(counters), counters.size):
+                    raise RuntimeError("Cannot read owned process private RAM")
+                private += counters.private
+            finally:
+                kernel.CloseHandle(process)
+    current = private / 1024 ** 3
+    _peak_private = max(_peak_private, current)
+    return {"process_tree_private_ram_gb": current, "peak_process_tree_private_ram_gb": _peak_private,
+            "worker_process_count": count - 1}

--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/bme_eating/joint_v411_scoring.py
@@ -0,0 +1,119 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+
+import torch
+
+from bme_eating.models.statsfusion_joint_event import distribution_endpoint, gaussian_distribution
+from bme_eating.models.statsfusion_joint_event_v411 import indexed_roi
+
+
+def score_candidates(model, candidates, times, features, device, *, batch_size=128, cache=None):
+    if not candidates:
+        return []
+    outputs = []
+    for first in range(0, len(candidates), batch_size):
+        pool, rois = candidates[first:first + batch_size], []
+        for candidate in pool:
+            left = min(candidate.start_ms, candidate.end_ms) - 60_000
+            right = min(candidate.end_ms + 60_000, candidate.decision_time_ms)
+            limits = torch.searchsorted(times, torch.tensor([left, right]), right=True).tolist()
+            support_times, support = times[limits[0]:limits[1]], features[limits[0]:limits[1]]
+            if len(support):
+                candidate.missing_fraction = float(support[:, 136].mean().detach())
+                candidate.gyro_missing = bool((support[:, 135] <= 0).all())
+            roi = cache.get(candidate) if cache is not None else None
+            if roi is None:
+                roi = indexed_roi(support[:, :64], support[:, 64:128], support_times,
+                                  support[:, 128], candidate.start_ms, candidate.end_ms,
+                                  candidate.decision_time_ms)
+                if cache is not None:
+                    cache.put(candidate, roi)
+            rois.append(roi)
+        scores = model.candidate_head(torch.stack(rois).to(device),
+                                      torch.stack([candidate.metadata(device) for candidate in pool]))
+        detached = torch.stack((scores["event_logit"], scores["quality_logit"].sigmoid()), -1).detach().cpu()
+        for index, candidate in enumerate(pool):
+            candidate.event_logit, candidate.predicted_quality = detached[index].tolist()
+            candidate.score_formula = "calibrated_event_probability_v411"
+            outputs.append({name: value[index:index + 1] for name, value in scores.items()})
+    return outputs
+
+
+def boundary_support(model, candidate, times, features, device, boundary, embedding, endpoint):
+    center = candidate.start_ms if endpoint == 0 else candidate.end_ms
+    seconds = boundary["start_range_seconds"] if endpoint == 0 else boundary.get("end_range_seconds", 30)
+    limits = torch.searchsorted(times, torch.tensor([center - seconds * 1000 - 1,
+                                                    min(center + seconds * 1000,
+                                                        candidate.decision_time_ms)]), right=True).tolist()
+    support, values = times[limits[0]:limits[1]], features[limits[0]:limits[1]]
+    valid = values[:, 128] > 0
+    support, values = support[valid].to(device), values[valid].to(device)
+    if len(support) < 3:
+        return support, None
+    logits = model.boundary_head(values[:, 64:128], (support - center).float() / 1000,
+                                 embedding, values[:, 128], values[:, 133], values[:, 134])[:, endpoint]
+    return support, logits
+
+
+def refine(model, candidate, times, features, device, boundary, entropy, *, embedding=None,
+           rescore=True):
+    result = copy.deepcopy(candidate)
+    result.unrefined_start_ms, result.unrefined_end_ms = candidate.start_ms, candidate.end_ms
+    result.coarse_event_logit, result.coarse_quality = candidate.event_logit, candidate.predicted_quality
+    mode = boundary.get("mode", "both")
+    result.boundary_mode = mode
+
+    def fallback(reason):
+        result.start_ms, result.end_ms, result.refined = candidate.start_ms, candidate.end_ms, False
+        result.boundary_fallback_reason = reason
+        result.boundary_conflict = reason in {"conflict_or_latency", "insufficient_valid_bins"}
+        return result
+
+    if mode == "off" or not boundary.get("qualified") or candidate.source == "truth_jitter":
+        return fallback("disabled")
+    if embedding is None:
+        embedding = score_candidates(model, [candidate], times, features, device)[0]["candidate_embedding"][0]
+    for endpoint in ((0,) if mode == "start_only" else (0, 1)):
+        support, logits = boundary_support(model, candidate, times, features, device, boundary,
+                                           embedding, endpoint)
+        name = "start" if endpoint == 0 else "end"
+        setattr(result, "boundary_valid_" + name + "_bins", len(support))
+        if logits is None:
+            return fallback("insufficient_valid_bins")
+        proposal, uncertainty = distribution_endpoint(logits, support)
+        setattr(result, "boundary_" + name + "_entropy", uncertainty)
+        if uncertainty > entropy:
+            return fallback("entropy")
+        seconds = boundary["start_range_seconds"] if endpoint == 0 else boundary.get("end_range_seconds", 30)
+        result.boundary_clipped |= abs(proposal - getattr(candidate, name + "_ms")) >= seconds * 1000 - 3000
+        setattr(result, name + "_ms", proposal)
+    if not result.start_ms < result.end_ms <= candidate.decision_time_ms or (
+            candidate.decision_time_ms - result.end_ms > 60_000):
+        return fallback("conflict_or_latency")
+    result.refined = result.start_ms != candidate.start_ms or result.end_ms != candidate.end_ms
+    if result.refined and rescore:
+        score_candidates(model, [result], times, features, device)
+    result.validate()
+    return result
+
+
+def boundary_loss(model, candidate, target, times, features, device, boundary, embedding):
+    positive, _, _, true_start, true_end = target
+    zero = embedding.sum() * 0
+    if not positive:
+        return zero
+    losses = []
+    for endpoint, truth_endpoint in enumerate((true_start, true_end)):
+        if truth_endpoint > candidate.decision_time_ms:
+            continue
+        center = candidate.start_ms if endpoint == 0 else candidate.end_ms
+        maximum = boundary["start_range_seconds"] if endpoint == 0 else boundary.get("end_range_seconds", 30)
+        if abs(truth_endpoint - center) > maximum * 1000:
+            continue
+        support, logits = boundary_support(model, candidate, times, features, device, boundary,
+                                           embedding, endpoint)
+        if logits is not None and int(support[0]) <= truth_endpoint <= int(support[-1]):
+            distribution = gaussian_distribution(support, truth_endpoint, boundary.get("sigma_seconds", 9))
+            losses.append(-(distribution * logits.float().log_softmax(0)).sum())
+    return torch.stack(losses).mean() if losses else zero

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+import time
+from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor
+from itertools import product
+
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+from scipy.optimize import linear_sum_assignment
+
+from bme_eating.joint_evaluation import (
+    NonnegativePlatt,
+    apply_online_budget,
+    calibration_ece,
+    candidate_coverage,
+    event_frame,
+)
+from bme_eating.joint_stream import candidate_targets
+from bme_eating.metrics import interval_iou_matrix, prediction_ignore_mask
+
+
+class CachedSearch:
+    def __init__(self, candidates, truth, ignore, windows, calibrator):
+        self.candidates, self.truth = candidates, truth
+        self.hours = float((windows.valid > 0).sum() * 3 / 3600)
+        probabilities = calibrator.transform(np.asarray([item.event_logit for item in candidates]))
+        self.groups = []
+        sessions = sorted({(item.subject_key, item.session_id) for item in candidates}
+                          | set(truth[["subject_key", "session_id"]].astype(str).itertuples(index=False, name=None)))
+        for subject, session in sessions:
+            indices = [index for index, item in enumerate(candidates)
+                       if (item.subject_key, item.session_id) == (subject, session)]
+            pool = [candidates[index] for index in indices]
+            target = truth[truth.subject_key.astype(str).eq(subject) & truth.session_id.astype(str).eq(session)]
+            target_coordinates = target[["start_ms", "end_ms"]].to_numpy()
+            coordinates = np.asarray([[item.start_ms, item.end_ms] for item in pool]).reshape(-1, 2)
+            iou = interval_iou_matrix(target_coordinates, coordinates)
+            overlap = interval_iou_matrix(coordinates, coordinates)
+            ignored = prediction_ignore_mask(event_frame(pool), ignore)
+            decisions = {}
+            for index, item in enumerate(pool):
+                decisions.setdefault(item.decision_time_ms, {}).setdefault(item.ancestor_id, []).append(index)
+            self.groups.append((pool, target, target_coordinates, coordinates, iou, overlap, ignored,
+                                probabilities[indices], [decisions[key] for key in sorted(decisions)]))
+
+    def evaluate(self, acceptance, nms):
+        tp, fp, ignored_count = 0, 0, 0
+        start_errors, end_errors, hands = [], [], {name: 0 for name in ("same", "different", "unknown")}
+        for pool, target, target_coordinates, coordinates, iou, overlap, ignored, probabilities, decisions in self.groups:
+            committed = []
+            for parents in decisions:
+                winners = []
+                for versions in parents.values():
+                    eligible = [index for index in versions if probabilities[index] >= acceptance]
+                    if eligible:
+                        def priority(index, pool=pool, probabilities=probabilities):
+                            item = pool[index]
+                            entropy = [value for value in (item.boundary_start_entropy,
+                                       item.boundary_end_entropy) if value is not None]
+                            return (-item.predicted_quality, max(entropy, default=1),
+                                    -probabilities[index], item.proposal_id)
+                        winners.append(min(eligible, key=priority))
+                winners.sort(key=lambda index: (-probabilities[index], -pool[index].predicted_quality,
+                                                pool[index].proposal_id))
+                for index in winners:
+                    if not committed or not (overlap[committed, index] > nms).any():
+                        committed.append(index)
+            matrix = iou[:, committed]
+            count_truth, count_prediction = matrix.shape
+            matches = []
+            if matrix.size:
+                bonus = float(min(count_truth, count_prediction) + 1)
+                scores = np.zeros((count_truth + count_prediction,) * 2)
+                scores[:count_truth, :count_prediction] = np.where(matrix > .25, bonus + matrix, -bonus)
+                rows, columns = linear_sum_assignment(-scores)
+                matches = [(row, committed[column]) for row, column in zip(rows, columns)
+                           if row < count_truth and column < count_prediction and matrix[row, column] > .25]
+            matched = {column for _, column in matches}
+            ignored_predictions = sum(bool(ignored[index]) and index not in matched for index in committed)
+            tp += len(matches)
+            fp += len(committed) - ignored_predictions - len(matches)
+            ignored_count += ignored_predictions
+            for row, column in matches:
+                start_errors.append(coordinates[column, 0] - target_coordinates[row, 0])
+                end_errors.append(coordinates[column, 1] - target_coordinates[row, 1])
+                hand = str(target.iloc[row].get("hand_relation", "unknown"))
+                hands[hand if hand in hands else "unknown"] += 1
+        fn = len(self.truth) - tp
+        precision, recall = tp / max(tp + fp, 1), tp / max(tp + fn, 1)
+        metrics = {"true_positive": float(tp), "false_positive": float(fp), "false_negative": float(fn),
+                   "ignored_predictions": float(ignored_count), "precision": precision,
+                   "sensitivity": recall, "f1": 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) if precision + recall else 0,
+                   "observed_hours": self.hours, "fp_per_hour": fp / self.hours if self.hours else float("inf")}
+        for name, errors in (("start", start_errors), ("end", end_errors)):
+            metrics[name + "_mae_seconds"] = float(np.mean(np.abs(errors)) / 1000) if errors else float("nan")
+            metrics[name + "_signed_error_seconds"] = float(np.mean(errors) / 1000) if errors else float("nan")
+        for hand, matched_count in hands.items():
+            denominator = int(self.truth.get("hand_relation", pd.Series("unknown", index=self.truth.index)).eq(hand).sum())
+            metrics[hand + "_recall"] = matched_count / denominator if denominator else None
+        return metrics
+
+
+def search_group(payload):
+    import os
+    os.environ.setdefault("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "1")
+    natural, truth, ignore, windows, registered, config, calibrator, coverage, ece = payload
+    cache = CachedSearch(natural, truth, ignore, windows, calibrator)
+    thresholds = np.arange(config["search"]["acceptance_min"], config["search"]["acceptance_max"] + 1e-8,
+                           config["search"]["acceptance_step"])
+    qualified = calibrator.qualified and ece <= config["calibration"]["maximum_ece"] and coverage["recall"] >= .70
+    records = []
+    for nms, acceptance in product(config["search"]["nms_ious"], thresholds):
+        metrics = cache.evaluate(float(acceptance), nms)
+        records.append({**registered, "nms": nms, "acceptance": float(acceptance),
+            "calibration": calibrator.to_json(), "calibration_ece": ece,
+            "candidate_recall": coverage["recall"], "promotion_eligible": qualified and
+            metrics["fp_per_hour"] <= config["gates"]["maximum_fp_per_hour"], **metrics})
+    return records
+
+
+def choose_point(candidate_sets, windows, truth, ignore, mappings, config):
+    started = time.monotonic()
+    payloads, audits = [], {}
+    for setting, candidates in candidate_sets.items():
+        for budget in config["search"]["budgets"]:
+            natural, audit = apply_online_budget(candidates, windows, mappings, budget, {})
+            if any(item.source == "truth_jitter" or item.generation_parameters.get("training_only") for item in natural):
+                raise RuntimeError("Natural calibration contains training-only candidates")
+            labels = np.asarray([candidate_targets(item, truth)[0] for item in natural])
+            ignored = prediction_ignore_mask(event_frame(natural), ignore)
+            keep = ~ignored | (labels > 0)
+            logits = np.asarray([item.event_logit for item in natural])
+            calibrator = NonnegativePlatt.fit(logits[keep], labels[keep])
+            ece = calibration_ece(calibrator.transform(logits[keep]), labels[keep], config["calibration"]["bins"])
+            coverage = candidate_coverage(natural, truth, windows)
+            payloads.append((copy.deepcopy(natural), truth, ignore, windows[["valid"]],
+                             {"setting": setting, "budget": budget}, config, calibrator, coverage, ece))
+            audits[(setting, budget)] = audit
+    workers = min(config["resources"]["search_processes"], len(payloads))
+    if workers == 1:
+        groups = map(search_group, payloads)
+        records = [record for group in groups for record in group]
+    else:
+        with ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as executor:
+            records = [record for group in executor.map(search_group, payloads) for record in group]
+    best, best_key = None, None
+    for record in records:
+        bias = record["start_signed_error_seconds"]
+        key = (int(record["promotion_eligible"]), record["f1"], -record["fp_per_hour"],
+               record["candidate_recall"], -abs(bias) if np.isfinite(bias) else -float("inf"))
+        if best_key is None or key > best_key:
+            best, best_key = record, key
+    if best is None:
+        raise RuntimeError("No registered operating points")
+    return {**best, "budget_audit": audits[(best["setting"], best["budget"])],
+            "search_seconds": time.monotonic() - started,
+            "registered_operating_points": len(records)}, records
diff --git a/src/bme_eating/joint_v411_stream.py b/src/bme_eating/joint_v411_stream.py

@@ -0,0 +1,102 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+from collections import deque
+
+from bme_eating.joint_stream import StreamingProposals, stable_id
+
+
+class LearnedStreamingProposals(StreamingProposals):
+    def __init__(self, *arguments):

+    def observe(self, timestamp, probabilities, valid, offset_probability=0.0,

+            raise ValueError("Invalid onset probability")

+            center = samples[3]
+            if (center[2] > 0 and center[1] >= self.config["onset_peak_threshold"]

+                    and center[0] - samples[0][0] == 9000

+                    and all(center[1] >= value[1] for value in samples[4:])):

+        result = []

+                            and int(self.origin) <= peak[0] < coarse.end_ms),
+                           key=lambda peak: (-peak[1], peak[0]))
+            selected = []
+            for peak in peaks:
+                if all(abs(peak[0] - other[0]) >= 15_000 for other in selected):
+                    selected.append(peak)
+                if len(selected) == 2:
+                    break
+            if self.config.get("ablation") == "no_onset":
+                variants = pool
+            elif selected:
+                variants = [coarse]
+                for timestamp, probability in selected:
+                    version = copy.deepcopy(coarse)
+                    version.start_ms, version.source = timestamp, "learned_onset"
+                    version.proposal_id = stable_id(coarse.ancestor_id, timestamp, coarse.end_ms,

+                for item in sorted(pool, key=lambda item: item.proposal_id):

+                    if geometry not in geometries:

+                    if len(variants) == 3:

+            unique = {}
+            for candidate in variants:
+                geometry = candidate.start_ms, candidate.end_ms
+                flags = [candidate.source, candidate.generation_parameters["parent_source"]]
+                if geometry in unique:
+                    previous = unique[geometry]
+                    previous.generation_parameters["source_flags"] = sorted(set(
+                        previous.generation_parameters["source_flags"] + flags))
+                    continue
+                candidate.generation_parameters.update({"v411": True,
+                    "source_flags": sorted(set(flags)), "parent_raw_score": coarse.raw_score,
+                    "learned_peak_count": len(selected), "compatibility_fallback": not bool(selected),
+                    "coarse_parent_id": coarse.ancestor_id})
+                candidate.score_formula = "calibrated_event_probability_v411"
+                candidate.validate()

+            for item in pool:
+                geometry = item.start_ms, item.end_ms
+                if geometry in unique:

+                    kept.generation_parameters["source_flags"] = sorted(set(
+                        kept.generation_parameters["source_flags"] + [item.source]))

+    return StreamingProposals(subject, session, identity, decoder)

+from __future__ import annotations

+def sample_groups(candidates, truth, config, rng, counts, teacher_fraction=0):
+    groups = {}
+    for candidate in candidates:
+        parent = (candidate.subject_key, candidate.session_id, candidate.ancestor_id)
+        groups.setdefault(parent, {})[(candidate.start_ms, candidate.end_ms)] = candidate
+    buckets = {name: [] for name in ("positive", "near_miss", "hard_false_positive", "random_background")}
+    quotas = config["training"]["group_quotas"]
+    if config.get("ablation", {}).get("name") == "single_candidate":
+        maximum_versions = 1
+    else:
+        maximum_versions = config["training"]["versions_per_group"]
+    maximum_groups = (1 if maximum_versions == 1 else config["training"]["maximum_groups_per_positive_event"])
+    event_groups = []
+    for versions in groups.values():
+        versions = list(versions.values())
+        targets = {item.proposal_id: candidate_targets(item, truth) for item in versions}
+        positive_events = {target[2] for target in targets.values() if target[0]}
+        partitioned = {}
+        for item in versions:
+            target = targets[item.proposal_id]
+            event = target[2] if target[2] in positive_events else None
+            partitioned.setdefault(event, []).append(item)
+        event_groups.extend(partitioned.values())
+    for versions in event_groups:
+        targets = {item.proposal_id: candidate_targets(item, truth) for item in versions}
+        representative = max(versions, key=lambda item: (targets[item.proposal_id][1], item.proposal_id))
+        target = targets[representative.proposal_id]
+        category = "positive" if target[0] else "near_miss" if target[1] > 0 else (
+            "random_background" if representative.generation_parameters.get("sampling") == "random_background"
+            or representative.raw_score < .10 else "hard_false_positive")
+        identity = (representative.subject_key, representative.session_id, target[2])
+        if category == "positive" and counts.get(identity, 0) >= maximum_groups:
+            continue
+        bins, selected = set(), []
+        for candidate in sorted(versions, key=lambda item: (-targets[item.proposal_id][1], item.proposal_id)):
+            iou_bin = int(targets[candidate.proposal_id][1] * 10)
+            if iou_bin not in bins:
+                selected.append(candidate)
+                bins.add(iou_bin)
+            if len(selected) == maximum_versions:
+                break
+        for candidate in sorted(versions, key=lambda item: item.proposal_id):
+            if len(selected) >= maximum_versions:
+                break
+            if candidate not in selected:
+                selected.append(candidate)
+        buckets[category].append({"versions": selected, "category": category,
+                                  "event_key": identity, "family": representative.proposal_family_id})
+    chosen, negative_families, audit = [], set(), {}
+    for category, quota in quotas.items():
+        pool = buckets[category]
+        rng.shuffle(pool)
+        selected = 0
+        teacher_count = 0
+        for group in pool:
+            teacher = any(item.source == "truth_jitter" for item in group["versions"])
+            if teacher and teacher_count >= int(quota * teacher_fraction + .5):
+                continue
+            if category == "positive":
+                key = group["event_key"]
+                if counts.get(key, 0) >= maximum_groups:
+                    continue
+                counts[key] = counts.get(key, 0) + 1
+            elif group["family"] in negative_families:
+                continue
+            else:
+                negative_families.add(group["family"])
+            chosen.append(group)
+            selected += 1
+            teacher_count += int(teacher)
+            if selected == quota:

+                           "deficit": quota - selected}

+                    "independent_positive_events": len({group["event_key"] for group in chosen if group["category"] == "positive"}),
+                    "independent_negative_families": len(negative_families), "categories": audit}
+
+
+def group_losses(model, groups, truth, times, features, device, boundary, config, schedule):
+    candidates = [candidate for group in groups for candidate in group["versions"]]
+    scores = score_candidates(model, candidates, times, features, device,
+                               batch_size=max(1, len(candidates)))
+    score_by_id = {candidate.proposal_id: score for candidate, score in zip(candidates, scores)}
+    results, label_changes = [], []
+    for group in groups:
+        losses = {name: [] for name in ("event", "quality", "boundary")}
+        quality_pairs = []
+        for candidate in group["versions"]:
+            score = score_by_id[candidate.proposal_id]
+            target = candidate_targets(candidate, truth)
+            positive, quality = target[:2]
+            event_loss = F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(score["event_logit"].float(),
+                                                            torch.tensor([positive], device=device))
+            quality_loss = quality_focal_loss(score["quality_logit"].float(),
+                torch.tensor([quality], device=device), config["loss"]["quality_beta"]).mean()
+            candidate_boundary = boundary_loss(model, candidate, target, times, features, device,
+                boundary, score["candidate_embedding"][0]) if schedule["boundary"] and (
+                    config.get("ablation", {}).get("name") != "no_boundary") else score["event_logit"].sum() * 0
+            if schedule["boundary"] and config.get("ablation", {}).get("name") != "no_boundary":
+                with torch.no_grad():
+                    refined = refine(model, candidate, times, features, device,
+                        {**boundary, "qualified": True, "mode": "both"}, .65,
+                        embedding=score["candidate_embedding"][0].detach(), rescore=False)
+                if refined.refined:
+                    new_target = candidate_targets(refined, truth)
+                    new_score = score_candidates(model, [refined], times, features, device)[0]
+                    event_loss = (event_loss + F.binary_cross_entropy_with_logits(
+                        new_score["event_logit"].float(), torch.tensor([new_target[0]], device=device))) / 2
+                    quality_loss = (quality_loss + quality_focal_loss(new_score["quality_logit"].float(),
+                        torch.tensor([new_target[1]], device=device), config["loss"]["quality_beta"]).mean()) / 2
+                    candidate_boundary = (candidate_boundary + boundary_loss(model, refined, new_target,
+                        times, features, device, boundary, new_score["candidate_embedding"][0])) / 2
+                    label_changes.append({"proposal_id": candidate.proposal_id,
+                        "before_target": list(target), "after_target": list(new_target)})
+            losses["event"].append(event_loss)
+            losses["quality"].append(quality_loss)
+            losses["boundary"].append(candidate_boundary)
+            quality_pairs.append((quality, score["quality_logit"].float().squeeze()))
+        ranking = []
+        if config.get("ablation", {}).get("name") != "single_candidate":
+            for first, (left_quality, left_score) in enumerate(quality_pairs):
+                for right_quality, right_score in quality_pairs[first + 1:]:
+                    difference = left_quality - right_quality
+                    if abs(difference) >= config["loss"]["ranking_minimum_iou_difference"]:
+                        ranking.append(F.softplus(-(left_score - right_score) * (1 if difference > 0 else -1)))
+        tasks = {name: torch.stack(values).mean() for name, values in losses.items()}
+        tasks["quality_ranking"] = torch.stack(ranking).mean() if ranking else tasks["quality"] * 0
+        results.append((group, tasks))
+    return results, label_changes
