+class PositiveGradientBuffer:
+    def __init__(self, state):
+        self.state = state
+
+    def add(self, key, loss, model):
+        parameters = list(model.named_parameters())
+        gradients = torch.autograd.grad(loss, [parameter for _, parameter in parameters],
+                                        retain_graph=True, allow_unused=True)
+        event = self.state.setdefault(key, {"groups": 0, "gradients": {}})
+        event["groups"] += 1
+        for (name, _), gradient in zip(parameters, gradients):
+            if gradient is not None:
+                value = gradient.detach().float().cpu()
+                if name not in event["gradients"]:
+                    event["gradients"][name] = value.clone()
+                else:
+                    event["gradients"][name].add_(value)
+
+    def finish(self, model, accumulate_sessions):
+        count = len(self.state)
+        for name, parameter in model.named_parameters():
+            values = [event["gradients"][name] / event["groups"] for event in self.state.values()
+                      if name in event["gradients"]]
+            if values:
+                gradient = torch.stack(values).sum(0).to(parameter.device) / (count * accumulate_sessions)
+                if parameter.grad is None:
+                    parameter.grad = gradient
+                else:
+                    parameter.grad.add_(gradient)
+        self.state.clear()
+

+def historical_contrastive(model, current, current_ids, current_phases, times, history, truth,
+                           subject, session, config, *, ignore=None):
+    from bme_eating.models.statsfusion_joint_event import event_contrastive_loss
+    limit = config["loss"]["contrastive_max_pairs"]
+    selected = truth[(truth.subject_key.astype(str) == subject) & (truth.session_id.astype(str) == session)]
+    masks, identities, phases = [], [], []
+    valid_history = history[:, 128] > 0
+    if ignore is not None and len(ignore):
+        excluded = ignore[(ignore.subject_key.astype(str) == subject) & (ignore.session_id.astype(str) == session)]
+        for interval in excluded.itertuples(index=False):
+            valid_history &= ~((times > interval.start_ms) & (times <= interval.end_ms))
+    for index, event in enumerate(selected.itertuples(index=False)):
+        eligible = (times > event.start_ms + 30_000) & (times < event.end_ms - 30_000) & valid_history
+        indices = eligible.nonzero().flatten()
+        if len(indices):
+            indices = indices[torch.linspace(0, len(indices) - 1, min(len(indices), 12)).long()]
+            masks.extend(indices.tolist())
+            identities.extend([index] * len(indices))
+            phases.extend((((times[indices] - event.start_ms) * 3) //
+                           (event.end_ms - event.start_ms)).clamp(0, 2).tolist())
+    projected = model.contrastive_projection(current)
+    if not masks:
+        return event_contrastive_loss(projected, current_ids, current_phases,
+            temperature=config["loss"]["contrastive_temperature"], maximum_pairs=limit)
+    chosen = sorted(zip(masks, identities, phases))[:limit]
+    mask = torch.zeros(len(times), dtype=torch.bool)
+    mask[[item[0] for item in chosen]] = True
+    with torch.no_grad():
+        values = history[mask]
+        historic = model.contrastive_projection(values[:, :64].to(current.device)).detach()
+    all_values = F.normalize(torch.cat((projected, historic)), dim=-1)
+    all_ids = torch.cat((current_ids, torch.tensor([item[1] for item in chosen], device=current.device)))
+    all_phases = torch.cat((current_phases, torch.tensor([item[2] for item in chosen], device=current.device)))
+    losses = []
+    anchors = ((current_ids >= 0) & (current_phases >= 0)).nonzero().flatten()[:limit]
+    for anchor in anchors.tolist():
+        positive = (all_ids == all_ids[anchor]) & (all_phases == all_phases[anchor])
+        positive[anchor] = False
+        negative = ((all_ids >= 0) | (all_ids == -2)) & (all_phases >= 0) & (all_ids != all_ids[anchor])
+        if positive.any() and negative.any():
+            similarities = all_values[anchor] @ all_values.T / config["loss"]["contrastive_temperature"]
+            losses.append(-(similarities[positive] - torch.logsumexp(similarities[positive | negative], 0)).mean())
+    return (torch.stack(losses).mean(), len(losses)) if losses else (projected.sum() * 0, 0)

+def indexed_roi(semantic, local, times, valid, start_ms, end_ms, decision_ms):
+    if not start_ms < end_ms <= decision_ms:
+        raise ValueError("Invalid causal ROI coordinates")
+    parts = ((start_ms - 60_000, start_ms, 4), (start_ms, end_ms, 16),
+             (end_ms, min(end_ms + 30_000, decision_ms), 4),
+             (start_ms - 60_000, start_ms + 60_000, 8),
+             (end_ms - 60_000, end_ms + 60_000, 8))
+    combined = torch.cat((semantic, local), -1)
+    tokens = []
+    for left, right, bins in parts:
+        edges = torch.linspace(left, right, bins + 1, dtype=torch.float64, device=times.device)
+        limits = torch.searchsorted(times, edges.clamp_max(decision_ms), right=True).tolist()
+        for index, (first, stop) in enumerate(itertools.pairwise(limits)):
+            values, weights = combined[first:stop], valid[first:stop].to(combined.dtype)
+            if len(values) and bool((weights > 0).any()):
+                mean = (values * weights[:, None]).sum(0) / weights.sum().clamp_min(1)
+                maximum = values.masked_fill(weights[:, None] <= 0, -torch.inf).amax(0)
+                fraction = weights.mean()
+            else:
+                mean = combined.new_zeros(combined.shape[-1])
+                maximum, fraction = mean, combined.new_zeros(())
+            relative = ((float(edges[index]) + float(edges[index + 1])) / 2 - start_ms)
+            tokens.append(torch.cat((mean, maximum, fraction[None],
+                                     combined.new_tensor([relative / max(end_ms - start_ms, 3000)]))))
+    return torch.stack(tokens)
+
+
+class CandidateHeadV411(JointCandidateHead):
+    def __init__(self, channels=64, dropout=0.1):
+        super().__init__(channels, dropout)
+        self.regions = nn.Embedding(5, channels)
+        self.register_buffer("region_ids", torch.tensor([0] * 4 + [1] * 16 + [2] * 4
+                                                        + [3] * 8 + [4] * 8))
+
+    def forward(self, roi, metadata):
+        if roi.shape[1:] != (40, 258):
+            raise ValueError("v411 requires forty aligned ROI tokens")
+        values = self.temporal(self.input(roi) + self.regions(self.region_ids)[None])
+        invalid = roi[..., -2] <= 0
+        all_invalid = invalid.all(1)
+        invalid = invalid.clone()
+        invalid[all_invalid, 0] = False
+        pooled, _ = self.pool(self.query.expand(len(roi), -1, -1), values, values,
+                              key_padding_mask=invalid, need_weights=False)
+        pooled = pooled[:, 0].masked_fill(all_invalid[:, None], 0)
+        embedding = self.classifier(torch.cat((pooled, self.metadata(metadata)), -1))
+        return {"event_logit": self.event(embedding).squeeze(-1),
+                "quality_logit": self.quality(embedding).squeeze(-1),
+                "candidate_embedding": embedding}
+
+
+class BoundaryHeadV411(nn.Module):
+    def __init__(self):
+        super().__init__()
+        self.head = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(132, 64), nn.SiLU(), nn.Linear(64, 2))
+
+    def forward(self, local, relative_seconds, embedding, validity, onset, offset):
+        if embedding.ndim == 1:
+            embedding = embedding[None].expand(len(local), -1)
+        scalars = torch.stack((relative_seconds / 900, validity, onset, offset), -1)
+        return self.head(torch.cat((local, embedding, scalars), -1))
+
+
+class StatsFusionJointEventV411(StatsFusionJointEvent):
+    is_v411 = True
+
+    def __init__(self, config):
+        super().__init__(config)
+        self.candidate_head = CandidateHeadV411(64, config["model"]["dropout"])
+        self.boundary_head = BoundaryHeadV411()
+
+
+def build_joint_model(config):
+    architecture = config["model"]["architecture"]
+    if architecture == "statsfusion_joint_event_v411":
+        return StatsFusionJointEventV411(config)
+    if architecture == "statsfusion_joint_event":
+        return StatsFusionJointEvent(config)
+    raise ValueError("Unregistered joint model architecture")

+class PackedCheckpointState:
+    def __init__(self, state):
+        self.payload = pickle.dumps(state, protocol=5)

+def cpu_checkpoint_snapshot(payload):
+    groups, replacements = {}, {}
+
+    def collect(value):
+        if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor) and value.device.type == "cuda":
+            key = (value.device, value.dtype)
+            if id(value) not in replacements:
+                groups.setdefault(key, []).append(value)
+                replacements[id(value)] = None
+        elif isinstance(value, dict):
+            for member in value.values():
+                collect(member)
+        elif isinstance(value, (list, tuple)):
+            for member in value:
+                collect(member)
+
+    sections = {key: payload[key] for key in ("model", "optimizer", "gradients") if key in payload}
+    collect(sections)
+    for members in groups.values():
+        packed = torch.cat([value.detach().reshape(-1) for value in members]).cpu()
+        offset = 0
+        for value in members:
+            replacements[id(value)] = packed[offset:offset + value.numel()].reshape(value.shape)
+            offset += value.numel()
+
+    def rebuild(value):
+        if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
+            return replacements.get(id(value), value)
+        if isinstance(value, dict):
+            result = copy.copy(value)
+            for key, member in value.items():
+                result[key] = rebuild(member)
+            return result
+        if isinstance(value, list):
+            return [rebuild(member) for member in value]
+        if isinstance(value, tuple):
+            return tuple(rebuild(member) for member in value)
+        return value
+
+    return {**payload, **rebuild(sections)}
+
+
+def training_checkpoint_snapshot(payload):
+    snapshot = cpu_checkpoint_snapshot(payload)
+    snapshot["state"] = PackedCheckpointState(payload["state"])

+def proposal_supervision(batch, cpu_batch, valid, scale_valid, factor):
+    target = batch["state_target"].float()
+    labels_valid = batch["state_loss_mask"]
+    scale_target, scale_mask = torch.zeros_like(target), torch.zeros_like(valid)
+    if factor > target.shape[1]:
+        return scale_target, scale_mask
+    completed = ((cpu_batch["timeline_position"][0, factor - 1:] + 1) % factor) == 0
+    selected = completed.nonzero().flatten()
+    if not len(selected):
+        return scale_target, scale_mask
+    weights = labels_valid.unfold(1, factor, 1)
+    denominator = weights.sum(-1)
+    targets = (target.unfold(1, factor, 1) * weights).sum(-1) / denominator.clamp_min(1)
+    endpoints = (selected + factor - 1).to(target.device, non_blocking=True)
+    scale_target[:, endpoints] = targets[:, selected.to(target.device, non_blocking=True)]
+    scale_mask[:, endpoints] = (valid[:, endpoints] * (scale_valid[:, endpoints] > 0)
+                                * (denominator[:, selected.to(target.device, non_blocking=True)] > 0))
+    cpu_target, cpu_weights = cpu_batch["state_target"], cpu_batch["state_loss_mask"]
+    nonbinary = ((cpu_target != 0) & (cpu_target != 1)) | ((cpu_weights != 0) & (cpu_weights != 1))
+    fallback = nonbinary.unfold(1, factor, 1).any(-1).any(0) & completed
+    for position in fallback.nonzero().flatten().tolist():
+        endpoint = position + factor - 1
+        members = slice(position, endpoint + 1)
+        member_weights = labels_valid[:, members]
+        scale_target[:, endpoint] = ((target[:, members] * member_weights).sum(1)
+                                     / member_weights.sum(1).clamp_min(1))
+        scale_mask[:, endpoint] = (valid[:, endpoint] * (scale_valid[:, endpoint] > 0)
+                                   * (member_weights.sum(1) > 0))
+    return scale_target, scale_mask

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import copy
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+import pandas as pd
+import torch
+
+from bme_eating.config import load_config
+from bme_eating.data import deep_dataset
+from bme_eating.data.deep_dataset import Normalization
+from bme_eating.data.joint_sessions import JointSessionDataset, SessionChunkSampler, session_loader
+from bme_eating.data.session import SessionWindowReader

+from bme_eating.stats_features import STATS_FEATURE_COLUMNS
+
+STATISTICS_COLUMNS = [*(f"stat_{name}" for name in STATS_FEATURE_COLUMNS),
+                      *(f"stat_{name}_missing" for name in STATS_FEATURE_COLUMNS)]
+
+
+def native_session_frames(directory):
+    generator = np.random.default_rng(2026)
+    segment_rows, anchor_frames, event_rows = [], [], []
+    for subject in ("first", "second"):
+        for segment_index, (start, end) in enumerate(((0, 60_000), (60_010, 120_000))):
+            archive = directory / f"{subject}_{segment_index}.npz"
+            motion_times = np.arange(start, end + 1, 10, dtype=np.int64)
+            ppg_times = np.arange(start, end + 1, 20, dtype=np.int64)
+            motion_mask = np.ones((len(motion_times), 6), dtype=bool)
+            motion_mask[::7, 3:] = False
+            np.savez_compressed(archive, motion_timestamp_ms=motion_times,
+                motion_values=generator.normal(size=(len(motion_times), 6)).astype(np.float32),
+                motion_mask=motion_mask, ppg_timestamp_ms=ppg_times,
+                ppg_values=generator.normal(size=len(ppg_times)).astype(np.float32),
+                ppg_mask=np.arange(len(ppg_times)) % 13 != 0)
+            segment_rows.append({"subject_key": subject, "session_id": "session",
+                "segment_id": f"{subject}_{segment_index}", "segment_path": str(archive),
+                "start_ms": start, "end_ms": end})
+        times = np.arange(3000, 120_001, 3000, dtype=np.int64)
+        frame = pd.DataFrame({"subject_key": subject, "session_id": "session",
+            "timestamp_ms": times, "state_target": ((times > 12_000) & (times <= 45_000)).astype(float),
+            "state_loss_mask": 1.})
+        for name in STATS_FEATURE_COLUMNS:
+            frame[f"stat_{name}"] = generator.normal(size=len(times))
+            frame[f"stat_{name}_missing"] = 0.
+        anchor_frames.append(frame)
+        event_rows.append({"subject_key": subject, "session_id": "session", "start_ms": 12_000,
+                           "end_ms": 45_000, "valid_duration": True, "evaluable": True})
+    return pd.concat(anchor_frames, ignore_index=True), pd.DataFrame(segment_rows), pd.DataFrame(event_rows)
+
+
+def assert_equal_batches(first, second):
+    assert len(first) == len(second)
+    for original, changed in zip(first, second):
+        assert original.keys() == changed.keys()
+        for name, value in original.items():
+            if isinstance(value, torch.Tensor):
+                torch.testing.assert_close(value, changed[name], rtol=0, atol=0)
+            else:
+                assert value == changed[name]
+
+
+def test_larger_reader_cache_preserves_samples_and_avoids_repeated_decompression(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    _, segments, _ = native_session_frames(tmp_path)
+    readers = [SessionWindowReader(segments, cache_size=size) for size in (1, 2)]
+    archive_load = deep_dataset._load_segment_archive
+    loads = []
+
+    def counted_load(path):
+        loads.append(path)
+        return archive_load(path)
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(deep_dataset, "_load_segment_archive", counted_load)
+    results, counts = [], []
+    for reader in readers:
+        before = len(loads)
+        results.append([reader.read("session", 55_000, 65_000, subject_key="first")
+                        for _attempt in range(4)])
+        counts.append(len(loads) - before)
+    assert counts == [8, 2]
+    for baseline, optimized in zip(*results):
+        for name in baseline:
+            np.testing.assert_array_equal(baseline[name], optimized[name])
+
+
+def test_augmented_chunks_identical_after_prefetch_cache_change_and_resume(tmp_path):
+    anchors, segments, events = native_session_frames(tmp_path)
+    geometry = SequenceGeometry(supervised_steps=4, short_receptive_field_steps=7,
+        fused_short_receptive_field_steps=7, long_receptive_field_tokens=3)
+    config = load_config(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "configs/statsfusion_v410_joint_event.yaml")
+    config["training"]["num_workers"] = 2
+
+    def collect(cache, prefetch, start_chunk):
+        dataset = JointSessionDataset(anchors, segments, events,
+            Normalization(np.zeros(6), np.ones(6), 0., 1.),
+            statistics_columns=STATISTICS_COLUMNS, geometry=geometry,
+            training=True, seed=2026, reader_cache_size=cache,
+            ppg_modality_dropout=.2, gyro_modality_dropout=.1, rotation_augmentation_probability=.2)
+        sampler = SessionChunkSampler(dataset, 8, start_chunk=start_chunk)
+        settings = copy.deepcopy(config)
+        settings["training"]["loader_prefetch_factor"] = prefetch
+        settings["training"]["session_reader_cache_size"] = cache
+        return list(session_loader(dataset, sampler, settings)), sampler.identity
+
+    baseline, identity = collect(1, 1, 0)
+    optimized, changed_identity = collect(4, 4, 0)
+    resumed, resumed_identity = collect(4, 4, 3)
+    assert identity == changed_identity == resumed_identity
+    assert_equal_batches(baseline, optimized)
+    assert_equal_batches(baseline[3:], resumed)
+
+
+def test_io_profile_can_resume_without_changing_training_identity(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    config = load_config(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "configs/statsfusion_v410_joint_event.yaml")

+    baseline["training"]["session_reader_cache_size"] = 1

+    assert config["training"]["loader_prefetch_factor"] == 4
+    assert config["training"]["session_reader_cache_size"] == 4
+    assert config_identity(config) == config_identity(baseline)
+    monkeypatch.setattr("bme_eating.joint_protocol.runtime_identity", lambda: {"python": "same"})
+    source = tmp_path / "source"
+    source.mkdir()
+    run = initialize_run(baseline, source, tmp_path / "output", "run", {"data": "same"},

+    identity = (run / "identity.json").read_bytes()
+    assert initialize_run(config, source, tmp_path / "output", "run", {"data": "same"},
+                          fresh=False, skip_s0=True, historical_reference=None) == run
+    assert (run / "identity.json").read_bytes() == identity

+def legacy_proposal_supervision(batch, cpu_batch, valid, scale_valid, factor):
+    target = batch["state_target"].float()
+    scale_target, scale_mask = torch.zeros_like(target), torch.zeros_like(valid)
+    for endpoint in range(factor - 1, target.shape[1]):
+        if int((batch["timeline_position"][0, endpoint] + 1) % factor) != 0:
+            continue
+        members = slice(endpoint - factor + 1, endpoint + 1)
+        labels_valid = batch["state_loss_mask"][:, members]
+        scale_target[:, endpoint] = ((target[:, members] * labels_valid).sum(1)
+                                     / labels_valid.sum(1).clamp_min(1))
+        scale_mask[:, endpoint] = valid[:, endpoint] * (scale_valid[:, endpoint] > 0) * (labels_valid.sum(1) > 0)
+    return scale_target, scale_mask
+

+    target = torch.randint(0, 2, (2, 83), generator=generator).float()
+    weights = torch.randint(0, 2, (2, 83), generator=generator).float()
+    if kind == "soft":
+        target[:, 12:29] = torch.rand(2, 17, generator=generator)
+        weights[:, 24:41] = torch.rand(2, 17, generator=generator)
+    if kind == "missing":
+        weights.zero_()
+    cpu_batch = {"state_target": target, "state_loss_mask": weights,
+                 "timeline_position": torch.arange(-39, 44)[None].expand(2, -1)}
+    batch = {name: value.to(device) for name, value in cpu_batch.items()}
+    valid = torch.rand(2, 83, generator=generator).to(device)
+    scale_valid = torch.randint(0, 2, (2, 83), generator=generator).float().to(device)
+    expected = legacy_proposal_supervision(batch, cpu_batch, valid, scale_valid, factor)
+    actual = trainer.proposal_supervision(batch, cpu_batch, valid, scale_valid, factor)
+    for baseline, optimized in zip(expected, actual):
